stories.title: US Hormuz strike victim’s body reaches Deoria after 8 days:Family demands talks with CM Yogi; Rahul Gandhi reaches out
stories.summary: The body of Shivanand Chaurasia (38) from Deoria, who was killed in an American attack, was brought to his village Surauli on Wednesday evening. His wife and sister fainted looking at his body. His parents and brother are also in a terrible state, crying inconsolably. The family members refused to unload the body from the ambulance. The family is insisting on speaking with the CM. The family has 2 demands. First- Compensation of Rs 1 crore. Second - His wife should be given a government job. Earlier, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi spoke on the phone with Shivanand's wife and brother Ram Pravesh. He said: We will convey your demands to the government. We will put pressure on the government from our side. I will also write a letter regarding financial assistance. Leaders from SP and Congress are present at Shivanand's house. BJP's Rampur Karthana MLA Surendra Chaurasia has also reached the spot. Shivanand died on June 10 in an American attack near the Strait of Hormuz. He was on the Singapore ship 'MT Settebello'. Shivanand was an engine fitter on the ship and had gone abroad about 9 months ago. Look at 3 pictures Read the conversation between Rahul and Shivanand's brother... Shivanand's brother (Rampravesh)- Namaste sir Rahul Gandhi- What exactly happened there? Rampravesh- My brother was working on a ship, a missile hit there and he died on the spot. Rahul Gandhi- I see... and the body? The body hasn't been recovered yet? Rampravesh: The body has arrived. Rahul Gandhi- Okay, fine. I wanted to give you my love and support. Lots of love to the family from my side and if there is any work we can do, please let me know. Rampravesh- Okay. If his (Shivanand's) wife could get a job. If financial help could be provided for the child's education. That's the demand. Rahul Gandhi- Yes, we will convey this demand to the government. We will put pressure on the government from our side. I will write a letter regarding financial assistance. Rampravesh- Okay. Rahul Gandhi- We don't have our government in UP, so we can only put pressure. Rampravesh- Okay sir. A delegation of 20 people reached Shivanand's village Congress's former state president Ajay Kumar Lallu, district president Vijay Shekhar Mall, former district president Ramji Giri reached Shivanand's ancestral village Surauli on Wednesday with a delegation of 20 people. Here they met Shivanand's family members. They arranged a phone conversation between Rahul Gandhi and Shivanand's younger brother Rampravesh. Chairman Ajay Kumar Lallu, targeting the state government, said - The Deputy Chief Minister of the state attends private programs, but could not find time to inquire about the condition of this victim's family. Lallu alleged that the public representatives and administrative officers of the district have also not provided the expected assistance to the family so far. Demanded martyr status for Shivanand Lallu also said that despite such a major incident, the family had to wait for a long time for the mortal remains. He demanded from the government that Shivanand Chaurasia be given the status of a martyr. His family members should be given financial assistance of one crore rupees. One member of the family should also be given a government job. Along with this, the government should also repay the loan that Shivanand had taken for employment. Surauli village is about 10 km away from Deoria district headquarters. Ramji Chaurasiya's house is in the middle of the village. He has two sons Shivanand (38) and Ram Pravesh and one daughter Soni. Soni is married. Shivanand married Sushila in 2017. They have a five-year-old son Rajveer and a two-year-old daughter Vanika. In the family, father Ramji Chaurasiya does farming and animal husbandry work. Mother Kalawati Devi is a homemaker. Shivanand had left in 2012 Father Ramji Chaurasia said - Shivanand had completed high school from Ganga Prasad Inter College in Majhgawa in 2006 and intermediate in 2008. After completing his studies, Shivanand left home in 2012 in search of employment. He worked in many cities including Dubai, Mumbai, Lucknow, Pune and Solapur. During this time, he completed a Merchant Navy course. He also obtained the CDC (Continuous Discharge Certificate) required for working on a merchant ship. For this, approximately six lakh rupees were spent by borrowing from the village and relatives. In September 2025, Shivanand reached Singapore from Mumbai and started working on a shipping company's vessel. The father said - My son Shivanand got a job in the Merchant Navy 9 months ago. I took a loan of 6 lakh rupees to get his CDC certificate, that is, maritime passport made. His joining was in Singapore. From there, he boarded an oil ship for the first time. But I never imagined even in my dreams that his first voyage would become his last voyage. He was the only earning son of my household, who is no more now. What will happen to us, only God knows now... Rahul aggressive from day one Wrote on X - Our compromised PM is silent Rahul Gandhi has been raising this issue from the first day. On the American attacks, he wrote on X on June 12 - Three Indians died in American attacks on three ships in three days in international waters. And our compromised PM did not speak even a single word. When a foreign power kills an Indian, the Prime Minister has to speak. But there's no way he will speak even a word. Next week at G7, just a few days after the killing of our sailors, Modi ji will smile, embrace and make agreements. But, he won't have even a single word for those three Indians. A compromised PM cannot protect the sons of Bharat Mata, because he has neither the courage nor the strength to anger those who took the lives of those sons. 2 days later, Rahul wrote again on X - Just days after the killing of three Indian sailors in American attacks - no regret, no apology. On the contrary, America has continued to give orders. Read their words: "Comply immediately with US military orders." Any violation will "not be tolerated." A free country will never tolerate such language. But our compromised PM is silent. Listens like an obedient servant, and follows orders. A compromised PM will not protect the nation's honor - because those who insult the country have him under their control. Yesterday Modi raised the issue of Indians' deaths in Hormuz Modi's speech in 5 points 46 ships attacked in 108 days in Hormuz Strait On the first day of the summit on Tuesday, Modi raised the issue of deaths of Indian citizens in the Hormuz Strait. In the outreach session, he said that many Indians have lost their lives in this important maritime route and ensuring the safety of sailors connecting global trade is the responsibility of all countries.

stories.title: 65-year-old man rapes minor in Pilibhit:Kidnapped her from market, held hostage for 2 days
stories.summary: In Pilibhit, UP, a 65-year-old man held a girl hostage and raped her for 2 days. On Sunday, the 9-year-old girl had gone to the market to buy slippers. During this time, Mohammad Umar lured and abducted the girl. The family kept searching for the girl for two days, but she was not found. On Tuesday, a young man living in front of the accused's house secretly made a video of him raping the girl and sent it to the family. After seeing the video, the villagers reached Umar's house. When they looked there, the girl was lying in a distressed state. The accused had fled from the spot. The family handed over the video to the police. In it, he can be seen committing the heinous act. As soon as the matter came to light, a crowd surrounded the police station and demanded action. After this, the police arrested the accused late Tuesday night from outside the village. He was planning to flee from Pilibhit. The incident is from Sungarhi police station area, 7 kilometers away from the district headquarters. Accused's wife has already died, he lives alone in the village The girl studies in class 4. She is the youngest among four siblings. Apart from her, there are two elder brothers and one elder sister. The girl's father works at a shop in the market 200-300 meters away from the village. The accused Mohammad Umar lives alone in the village. He does not do any work. His wife had died of illness several years ago. One month ago, his one of the son also died. The second son works in the city. His daughter is married. Accused lured the girl and took her to his house According to police, the girl went to her father at the market on Sunday afternoon. She asked her father to buy new slippers. The father told the shopkeeper next door to give slippers to his daughter. After this, the girl went to the slipper shop. The father got busy with his work. Meanwhile, the accused Umar came and lured the girl and took her to his house. After a while, the father remembered his daughter. He looked at the shop next door, but the girl was not there. He thought she must have gone home. When the father returned from work at the shop, the girl was not at home either. He searched extensively, but could not find any trace of the girl. After this, he filed a missing person report with the police the same day. Raped after giving intoxicating substance According to police, the accused gave the girl an intoxicating substance mixed in food at home. After this, he raped the girl for two days. A young man living in front of the accused's house made a video and sent it to the family. In this, the accused is seen doing obscene acts with the girl. After seeing the video, family members rushed to the accused's house, where the girl was found in a distressed condition. SP said - Will ensure punishment as soon as possible through fast track court SP Sukeerti Madhav Mishra said- An objectionable video of rape with the girl has been found. A case has been registered against the accused under several serious sections including the POCSO Act and he has been arrested. The girl's medical examination is being conducted. Efforts will be made to ensure the strictest punishment as soon as possible by conducting a trial in the fast track court against the accused. Minister said Bulldozer will run on accused's house, seven generations will remember Regarding this case, UP government's Minister of State Sanjay Singh Gangwar held a press conference at his office in Pilibhit. Expressing strong outrage over the incident, he said I spoke to the SP and got the accused arrested immediately, but the action will not stop here. A bulldozer will definitely be run on the accused's house and such an example will be set that his seven generations will remember.

stories.title: Rare Shiva artefacts put on display:BHU launches 15-day special internship programme
stories.summary: Bharat Kala Bhavan, located at Banaras Hindu University, has launched a 15-day special internship programme for students, during which rare Lord Shiva artefacts will be showcased. Students who complete the training will be awarded certificates. Students from Banaras Hindu University, its affiliated colleges and some select external colleges will be eligible for the programme. Professor Shrirup Rai Choudhury, Director of Bharat Kala Bhavan, stated that this initiative has been taken with the aim of providing students with creative and practical experience alongside their studies, in line with the government's New Education Policy. He said that this internship will not only intellectually enrich the students but also provide them with an opportunity to understand the country's cultural heritage and connect with its preservation. First, see these three pictures 30 forms of Lord Shiva featured on nearly 2,000-year-old artefacts The complete life chronicle of Lord Shiva is depicted across 2,000-year-old coins, textiles, paintings, sculptures and terracotta figurines. Rare and unique artefacts of Shiva dating from the Shunga period (185–73 BCE) to the 18th Century are on display here. Ancient objects associated with Bholenath (Lord Shiva) feature prominently in the special 'Shiva Exhibition'. In these depictions, Shiva is portrayed both as the destroyer and the nurturer. While his worldly life is visible in some, others showcase him as a detached ascetic dwelling in the mountains. A data bank of rare items During the internship, students will get an opportunity to conduct research on selected heritage items from thousands of rare objects preserved in Bharat Kala Bhavan. Students will have to collect information such as the construction, historical background, materials used, period, place of acquisition, conservation process, and archaeological significance of the related items to prepare a detailed data bank. Undergraduate students will benefit According to Director Prof. Chaudhary, the greatest benefit of this programme will be received by students studying at the undergraduate level. They will gain knowledge about Indian cultural heritage, remnants of ancient civilisations, and modern conservation techniques. The research and data bank prepared by the students will be preserved by Bharat Kala Bhavan in its archives, and due credit will also be given to the respective students. He informed that many important antiquities obtained from Harappa, Mohenjo-Daro, Sarnath, and various parts of the country are preserved in the museum. Updating the information related to these is a complex and expensive task. In such a situation, the participation of students will not only provide them with a learning opportunity but also strengthen the museum's research and documentation work. Now, know how to apply Interested students must apply by filling out the Google Form available on the official website of Bharat Kala Bhavan. The selection of applicants will be based on their academic background, current course and field of interest. Currently, this opportunity is open exclusively to the university's internal students. The application process for students from external colleges will commence in July.

stories.title: Ram Mandir alleged theft row:PIL filed in Allahabad High Court; seeks CBI inquiry and CAG audit of temple funding records
stories.summary: A public interest litigation (PIL) filed regarding the alleged embezzlement and financial irregularities of offerings at the Ayodhya Ram Temple may be heard tomorrow, Thursday, in the Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court. It demands a CBI inquiry and an audit by the CAG. The petition has been listed for hearing before the division bench of Justice Saurabh Lavania and Justice Pramod Kumar Srivastava. According to advocate Mohit Ashok Sharma, representing the petitioner, the case has been listed at item number 466 in Court Number-2 in the cause list of June 18, 2026. He informed that a special mention (mentioning) will be made before the division bench in the morning for an expeditious hearing of the case. Possibility of inclusion in the supplementary list Advocate Mohit Ashok Sharma stated that no final update has been received yet. According to the Section Officer, if necessary, the matter may also be included in the supplementary list. He added that whether the hearing takes place or not will entirely depend on the discretion of the court. Can be considered a matter of national importance The petitioner's side says that if the court considers this matter to be of broad public interest and national importance and feels the need for an urgent hearing, then it can be heard on Thursday itself. However, the final decision will only become clear after mentioning it before the bench. The public interest litigation (PIL) demands an independent investigation into the alleged misuse of funds related to offerings and financial irregularities at the Ayodhya Ram Temple. It also demands an audit of the entire matter by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG). The matter is also being widely discussed in religious, social, and political circles.

stories.title: CBI reaches Lucknow in ₹7 crore education scam:Raids at 8 locations including Ayodhya, Amethi; investigation intensifies after High Court order
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) raided Ayodhya on Wednesday morning in connection with the investigation into the alleged multi-crore scam in the Finance and Accounts Department of Ayodhya Amethi. The CBI team reached a house near Devkali Police Post in Kotwali Nagar area at around 5:30 AM and started the investigation. The action caused a stir in the area, and a crowd of local people gathered. According to sources, the CBI investigated documents and other records at the residence of Pawan Kumar Malviya. The team collected several important pieces of information and examined facts related to the case. Local police were also kept on alert for necessary cooperation during the investigation. CBI investigating on court's direction It is being reported that the CBI is investigating the alleged financial irregularities worth crores of rupees in the Finance and Accounts Department of Amethi, following court orders. In this sequence, the agency took action simultaneously in several districts of Uttar Pradesh. Apart from Ayodhya, CBI teams also raided the premises of concerned people in Amethi, Lucknow, Pratapgarh, and Kushinagar. The investigation lasted for two and a half hours in Ayodhya This entire operation was conducted under the direction of CBI DIG Shivani Tiwari. After an investigation that lasted about two and a half hours in Ayodhya, the team departed from there at approximately 8 AM. However, CBI officials have not issued an official statement on any point related to the investigation. In the investigation of the scam, the CBI is continuously engaged in collecting documentary evidence and scrutinising financial transactions. It is believed that these raids conducted in various districts were aimed at advancing the investigation and clarifying the roles of people involved in the case. Currently, the agency's action is ongoing, and new revelations in the case are expected in the coming days.

stories.title: Varanasi becomes the second hottest city in India:Temperature touches 43°C, causing deserted ghats; monsoon to arrive by 25 June
stories.summary: Intense heat and humidity in Varanasi have affected daily life. On Wednesday morning, the city's temperature was recorded at 38 degrees Celsius, while the Meteorological Department has predicted it to reach 43 degrees Celsius by afternoon. Due to strong sunlight and humidity, people were seen forced to stay indoors since morning. According to the Meteorological Department, the wind speed in the city remains around 10 kilometres per hour, but due to approximately 50 per cent humidity, people are facing humid heat. The hot winds blowing since morning and the scorching sun have increased people's difficulties. See picture Rain alert on June 21-22 The Meteorological Department, expressing hope for relief, has stated that on June 21 and 22, due to the effect of thunderstorms, there may be rain with lightning and thunder. However, this relief is likely to be temporary, as a rise in temperature can be recorded once again from June 23. According to meteorologist Prof. Manoj Srivastava, the trend of rising temperatures will continue for now, and a significant change in weather will only be seen after the monsoon becomes active. Temperature rose by 7.6 degrees in 6 days Varanasi has recorded a significant increase in temperature over the past six days. On June 11, the maximum temperature was 35.4 degrees Celsius, which rose to 43 degrees Celsius by June 16. Thus, a jump of 7.6 degrees Celsius in temperature has been recorded in just six days. Due to continuously rising temperatures, roads appear deserted in the afternoon, and people are stepping out of their homes only for essential work. Electricity consumption rises again amidst the heat In Varanasi division, the peak electricity demand reached 2083 megawatts on Monday, which is considered one of the highest levels this season. Department officials state that continuous monitoring is being done to meet the increasing demand.

stories.title: Supreme Court grants relief to Uttar Pradesh teachers:TET exam to happen twice a year; one year extension given for clearing test
stories.summary: 1.86 lakh teachers teaching in UP's council schools have not yet been able to pass the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET). These teachers are working in primary and upper primary schools. 50 thousand of them could not take the exam due to lack of minimum qualification. Now the UP government has given relief to such teachers. It has relaxed some minimum educational qualifications. Additionally, it is preparing to conduct another TET exam for such teachers. For this, district-wise information of TET-passed and TET-failed teachers has been sought within a week. Decision taken after Supreme Court's extension The Supreme Court, on May 29, 2026, issued a new order by amending its previous order on the UP State vs. Anjuman Ishat-e-Taleem Trust Review Petition. In this order, the final deadline for teachers teaching in council schools without passing TET to pass the TET has been extended to August 31, 2028. Previously, this extension was till August 31, 2027. Special Secretary sought district-wise information on three points Following this order from the Supreme Court, Special Secretary Awadhesh Kumar Tiwari issued a letter to the Director of Basic Education on June 16. Through this letter, he has sought information on 3 points. This will require providing the total number of regularly working teachers district-wise in primary and upper primary schools. After this, the number of teachers who have passed TET/CTET will have to be provided. Then, information about teachers who have not yet passed TET needs to be given. Instructions have been given to provide this information within one week. This will require providing information about teachers working in council, recognized, and government schools. What is the Supreme Court's new order UPESSC has made a big change in the UPTET 2026 notification Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) issued the UPTET notification in March 2026 and made 3 major changes- A large number of such teachers will appear in the examination to be held in July Applications were invited for the TET examination in March. Apart from general candidates, 1.86 lakh teachers teaching in the state without passing TET have also applied. This examination is proposed for July 2, 3 and 4, 2026. However, these teachers have not been able to get an opportunity to prepare due to their census duties. Know how 1.86 lakh teachers of UP got caught in the TET tangle The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act (RTE-2009) was passed by Parliament on August 4, 2009, and implemented across the country from April 1, 2010. The objective of this law is to provide free and compulsory education to every child aged 6 to 14 years from class 1 to 8. Along with this, TET (Teacher Eligibility Test) was made mandatory as a minimum qualification for teachers. By issuing an order on July 27, 2011, TET was made a mandatory service condition for recruitment at primary and secondary levels. However, on September 1, 2025, a bench of Supreme Court Justices Dipankar Datta and Manmohan ruled that all teachers whose service tenure is more than 5 years remaining will be required to pass TET within 2 years (by August 31, 2027). Those with less service were given an exemption, but for promotion, they too were made to pass TET. UP Teachers Demanded Three TETs Teacher organizations argue that the mandatory nature of TET under RTE-2009 came into effect from July 2011. In such a situation, applying it to teachers appointed before that is not constitutional. Many teachers have been teaching for 20 to 25 years. They say that taking an exam again after so much service is not reasonable. Now, after extending the deadline by one year, teacher unions have demanded that the state government conduct three TETs. Question: What will happen to Shiksha Mitras and teachers of inter colleges? Dinesh Sharma, President of the Uttar Pradesh Primary Teachers' Association, says that the RTE-2009 Act is also effective in inter colleges for classes 6 to 8. In such a situation, teachers teaching classes 6 to 8 there will also have to pass TET. The number of such teachers in the state is also more than 20 thousand. After all, they too will come under the purview of the Supreme Court's order, then what will happen to them? There are also a large number of recognized and private colleges in the state. TET will be mandatory for those teachers as well. Then what steps will the government take in the case of Shiksha Mitras? Because they are also teaching children from class 1 to 8. Dinesh Sharma says that teacher recruitment in the state has been happening since 1993 according to the guidelines set by NCET (National Common Entrance Test). Meanwhile, teacher promotions in the state are determined based on seniority under the Teacher Service Rules 1981. How will they prepare for the exam amidst SIR and National Census? Shivshankar Singh, General Secretary of the National Educational Federation, says that earlier teachers were assigned SIR work along with academic tasks. Now they have been deployed in the national census campaign. In such a situation, they didn't even get a chance to prepare for UPTET, which is scheduled for July? He said that the government should provide relief to such teachers. Also, the UP government should also give exemption in TET for teachers, similar to Tamil Nadu. The Tamil Nadu government has brought an ordinance, keeping in mind the mandatory TET for about 4 lakh government and private teachers in the state, by lowering the qualifying marks. Along with this, the government has decided to conduct 6 TNTET (Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test) in two years.

stories.title: Cleanliness drive in Gorakhpur:Union minister sweeps the streets; exhorts public participation
stories.summary: Union Minister of State for Housing and Urban Affairs Tokhan Sahu participated in a cleanliness drive at Ramgarhtal Boating Point in Gorakhpur on Tuesday. Along with BJP office-bearers and workers, Sahu took a broom and cleaned the area. He said cleanliness is not just a campaign but the responsibility of every citizen. After the cleanliness campaign, the Union Minister planted saplings in the annexe of the building complex. He said everyone must come forward to protect the environment. "Every person should plant a sapling in their home, neighborhood, village and public places and also take care of them; only then will future generations get a better environment," he said. See 3 pictures Gorakhpur is forging a new identity of development Sahu hailed the changes in Gorakhpur, saying that compared to when he visited the place 10 years ago there was a world of difference. “Earlier, the city was plagued by problems of dirt, disorganisation and narrow roads but now Gorakhpur is rapidly progressing with wide roads, better infrastructure and modern facilities,” he said. He stated that on the occasion of the completion of 12 years of the central government under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, programmes related to service, cleanliness, and environmental protection are being organized across the country. People are being encouraged to adopt cleanliness and plant trees. Targeted the opposition over West Bengal Speaking to media persons, the Union Minister alluded to the political developments in West Bengal. He said that the public watches everything and gives its answer when the time comes. He said the present difficulties of Abhishek Banerjee and Mamata Banerjee were testimony to that. BJP State Vice President Dharmendra Singh, Metropolitan President Ramesh Pratap Gupta, along with other party office bearers and workers accompanied Sahu during the event. Everyone pledged to maintain cleanliness and play their part in environmental protection.

stories.title: OP Rajbhar claims SP to be split:Says, 'Ramgopal Yadav wrote letter to Amit Shah'; Akhilesh hits back
stories.summary: Just like Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena in Maharashtra, the Samajwadi Party (SP) is also going to split. This claim was made by UP Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar on Wednesday. Speaking to ANI, he said, "Don't pay attention to Maharashtra, now it's UP's turn." Rajbhar said: SP leader Ramgopal Yadav has written a letter to Home Minister Amit Shah. He has subtly told him that there are names of so many people. Call them and take them under your wing. Save our lives. If this is not the case, then Ramgopal ji should reveal what was written in that letter. What is his problem? SP has retaliated against Rajbhar's statement. Party spokesperson Sunil Singh said, "BJP and its allies are rattled. Rajbhar has a habit of talking nonsense. He should get treatment." Meanwhile, Akhilesh Yadav, in a press conference, quipped, “How long will the story of 'grain and song' continue?” Rajbhar said- Akhilesh gets BJP helped by Ramgopal Rajbhar said- CBI has also named Akhilesh Yadav in the mining case. He is currently out, in the same case as former minister Gayatri Prajapati, who is in jail. Did anyone go to jail in the Gomti Riverfront case? PM Modi had said in the House that sometimes Akhilesh ji also helps, so Akhilesh gets help from Ramgopal. He has given the same letter. SP spokesperson said- will wipe out BJP in 2027 SP spokesperson Sunil Singh said- SP has halved BJP in 2024, now it is preparing to wipe out the BJP in 2027. That's why the BJP and its allies are agitated. Omprakash Rajbhar is running his shop. He says something in the morning and something else in the evening. Claim of another split in the Uddhav faction in Maharashtra It is being claimed that 6 out of 9 Lok Sabha MPs of Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena (UBT) in Maharashtra may join the Shinde faction's Shiv Sena. These 6 MPs may meet Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla today. On this, Uddhav faction's Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Raut claimed in a press conference in Delhi that MPs have been offered Rs 50-50 crore. I have information that Rs 15-15 crore has been delivered to the MPs and they have been taken to Delhi by 3 chartered planes. On this, Rajbhar said - Leaders are ready to be sold, that's why this is happening. Create sustainable leaders. If you create someone who is for sale, they will be sold. Shiv Sena had split 4 years ago On June 20, 2022, 40 out of 55 Shiv Sena MLAs went with Shinde. At that time, Uddhav Thackeray was the Chief Minister. After the rebellion, the Governor directed the government to conduct a floor test. Uddhav Thackeray approached the Supreme Court, but the court did not stay the floor test. Subsequently, Uddhav resigned from the post of Chief Minister. On June 30, 2022, Shinde became the Chief Minister with the support of the BJP. After this, both factions filed petitions in the Supreme Court, demanding the disqualification of each other's MLAs. The court left the decision on this matter to Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar. On January 10, 2024, Speaker Rahul Narwekar, while delivering the verdict, stated that the Shinde faction had 37 MLAs at the time of the rebellion, and therefore, it would be considered the real political party of Shiv Sena. Narwekar rejected the disqualification petitions of both sides and did not cancel the membership of any MLA. Earlier, the Election Commission had also given the Shiv Sena's election symbol, bow and arrow, and the party's name to the Shinde faction.

stories.title: Pawan Singh-Ravi Kishan's dance sparks chaos in Ballia event:Police chase and beat spectators badly; multiple left injured on ground
stories.summary: A big event with Bhojpuri stars Pawan Singh and MP Ravi Kishan turned violent on Tuesday night. People threw chairs fiercely. Police chased the unruly crowd and beat them with sticks. Many people were injured. One youth's head was split open. More than 200 chairs were broken. The crowd went out of control three times during the show. Many BJP leaders, including Transport Minister Dayashankar, were present at the event. More than 25,000 people had come to see Pawan Singh and Ravi Kishan. Pawan Singh came on stage around 10:13 PM. When singer Shivani Singh performed the song 'Ae Saiyan Laika Niyan Sooti Jaale Kora Mein', the crowd became uncontrollable. Police first tried to control them by pushing and shoving. Later, Pawan Singh took the mic and came down from the stage while singing. Seeing this, the audience broke the barricades and tried to reach him. The situation became very bad, and the police had to do a lathi-charge. See the ruckus in pictures Police beat so severely that a head was split open More than 100 police personnel were deployed for the event. Seeing the barricades break, police personnel tried to stop the spectators. During this, the spectators started throwing chairs. In response, police personnel used batons to disperse the rioting spectators. Then at 11:30 PM, Pawan Singh was singing the song "Prakhand Ho Ya Zila Babuane Se Hila". Meanwhile, Pawan Singh came down from the stage. To see Pawan Singh up close, the crowd once again became uncontrollable and started throwing chairs. The police once again took charge and dispersed the crowd using force. After this, the event was called off. Sachin Kumar, a resident of Indaso, questioned the police action, stating that four police personnel beat him without any reason. He alleged that the police were unnecessarily chasing and beating the public, and when he was standing quietly watching, he was caught and beaten. People kept running here and there to escape. The event did not stop, the cake was cut on stage The event was organized by Vinay Singh, director of a private company, Shreyas Company. It was the birthday of Vinay Singh's son, Shreyas Singh. During this, Shreyas Singh cut the cake on stage in the presence of Pawan Singh and Ravi Kishan. Ravi Kishan and Pawan Singh chanted slogans of "Namah Parvati Patte Har-Har Mahadev". Then both of them also danced to songs like "Abhi Ho Dada, Kaisan Piyawa Ke Charitar Ba". The police kept lathi-charging the crowd, breaking the barricades to reach the stage. Meanwhile, the singing and dancing continued on stage. Ravi Kishan said - my brother is now an Honourable MLC Gorakhpur MP Ravi Kishan hugged Pawan Singh. During this, he said that my brother has now become honourable. Honourable MLC. I feel so good. When he became an MLC, he called. I congratulated him on Facebook first. The entire Bhojpuriya society is happy.

stories.title: 2 cars collide in Agra, 3 dead:Car goes out of control after tyre burst; crashes through divider into opposite lane; 11 injured
stories.summary: Three people died, and 11 were injured in a head-on collision between two cars in Agra. According to the police, 7 BSc students were travelling in one car, while members of a family were travelling in the other car. The accident occurred on the Agra-Gwalior Highway on Wednesday morning. As a car approached Kunal College in the Saiyan police station area, its tyre burst. This caused the car to lose control, break through the divider, and enter the opposite lane. At the same time, it collided head-on with another car coming from the opposite direction. The collision was so severe that the second car overturned. Upon receiving information, the police and local villagers reached the spot. They pulled the injured out of the cars and sent them to SN Medical College for treatment. The deceased have been identified as Rinku Sharma (son of Rakesh Sharma) from Tashiyo village in Dholpur district, Vivek Tiwari (son of Harimohan Tiwari) from Datia, Madhya Pradesh, and Meena Srivastava (wife of Ashok Srivastava).

stories.title: Ram Mandir worker Tinnu’s wife says family being defamed:SIT carries out 11-hour probe; Dimple Yadav says scams happen in other temples too
stories.summary: In the alleged donation theft case at the Ayodhya Ram Temple, Poonam Yadav, wife of temple trust employee Ramshankar Yadav alias Tinnu, has come forward after her husband. She dismissed claims that the family owns 50 rooms, hostels, hotels and luxury vehicles, calling them completely false. “We are being defamed. This is a conspiracy to frame my husband. If anyone has evidence, they should present it,” she said. Wife rejects claims of wealth and assets Tinnu has been in the spotlight since the alleged theft came to light. Earlier, he also released a video statement. He is considered a close associate of Champat Rai. Reports have claimed that gold was recovered from his residence by the trust’s investigation team, although no official confirmation has been issued. Meanwhile, on Wednesday, the Special Investigation Team (SIT) reached the temple premises around 10 am as the probe entered its third day. Sources suggest that investigators may question bank employees involved in counting the donations. SIT examines the entire donation handling process thoroughly On Tuesday, the SIT reportedly conducted an 11-hour inquiry inside the temple complex, questioning more than 100 individuals, including trust officials. Investigators examined the entire donation-handling process, including where donations are counted, who is involved in the counting, and who deposits the money in banks. Two crore rupees have been recovered during the investigation so far Five individuals have so far been named in the case Lavkush, Avneesh, Anukalp, Karune and Ramshankar. Based on information provided by the accused, authorities have reportedly recovered around ₹2 crore. All five were associated with the donation-counting process. Political leaders demand answers and a wider investigation Former Uttar Pradesh minister and Samajwadi Party leader Pawan Pandey had alleged on 7 June that between ₹5 crore and ₹7.5 crore had been stolen from the Ram Temple. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav also questioned the government’s silence on the matter and suggested that the courts should examine the case. In response, Champat Rai stated that no such confirmed findings had emerged at that stage. As the controversy grew, BJP leader Dr. Rajneesh Singh wrote to the Prime Minister on 9 June seeking a CBI investigation. The following day, the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) reportedly sought a report on the matter from the temple trust.

stories.title: Shopkeeper, company fined ₹10 lakh in Aligarh:Charged ₹20 extra for a packet of cigarettes; Consumer Forum Court calls it 'hidden loot against public'
stories.summary: In Uttar Pradesh's Aligarh, a shopkeeper and a cigarette manufacturing company have been fined ₹10 lakh for charging ₹20 extra for a packet of cigarettes. The shopkeeper charged ₹360 even though the cost was printed as ₹340 on the cigarette packet. An aggrieved customer made the payment online to the shopkeeper, then took a printout of the payment and filed a complaint with the Consumer Forum Court. The Consumer Forum Court pronounced its verdict after 5 months on June 16. The company argued that the shopkeeper was not its vendor, and therefore, the company was not responsible for black marketing. The court rejected this argument, stating, “Companies cannot disassociate themselves from black marketing. This is hidden loot against the general public.” Apart for the combined fine of ₹10 lakh, the court ordered, “The extra ₹20 collected from the victim should be returned with an 18 per cent annual interest. Also, a compensation of ₹5,000 for mental harassment and ₹5,000 for court expenses should be paid.” Know the full case Hira Lal Varshney, a resident of Pratibha Colony, has a shop right in front of the Aligarh District Consumer Commission. Advocate Devesh Gautam, a resident of Raghuvirpuri area under Banna Devi Police Station, bought a packet of cigarettes from Hira Lal in the last week of January. The maximum retail price of ₹340 was printed on the packet, but the shopkeeper demanded ₹360. When Devesh protested, the shopkeeper started arguing and refused to give the cigarettes. After this, Devesh made an online payment of ₹360. He got a printout of the digital payment and filed a case with evidence in the District Consumer Commission in February 2026. Company's Argument - Shopkeeper is not an authorized vendor The case was heard in the court of District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, President Hasnain Qureshi and member Poornima Singh Rajput. The court sent notices to the shopkeeper and a branded cigarette manufacturing company, but the shopkeeper did not appear. Meanwhile, the company argued that the shopkeeper was not its authorised vendor and it had no direct relation with him, therefore, the company is not responsible for black marketing. Court said - Deposit the fine within 45 days, otherwise action will be taken The consumer forum rejected the company's argument, stating that the shopkeeper was selling the company's product, and therefore, would be considered a sub-agent. The court imposed a fine of ₹10 lakh on the shopkeeper and the company, ordering it to be deposited in the Consumer Welfare Fund within 45 days. Additionally, it ordered ₹10,000 to be paid to the lawyer as compensation. A warning of strict action was issued if the fine and compensation are not paid within the stipulated time.

stories.title: Prayagraj triple murder case:'Kill my uncle or else we can't marry,' girlfriend told accused
stories.summary: Police arrested five people, including the boyfriend, in the Prayagraj triple murder case. These include the main accused, Himanshu Yadav (19), his brother, his 2 friends, and the village head. During police interrogation, boyfriend Himanshu said, he went to Rajapur village on 13 June to meet his girlfriend. Girlfriend told Himanshu that she would not be able to live without him. As long as her uncle Shyam Lal is alive, so their marriage will not be possible. She told Himanshu, ‘Remove uncle from the way'. After this, both of them made a plan to kill Shyam Lal. Himanshu also included his two friends, Nihal Gautam and Rajan Yadav, in the murder plan. Only Himanshu went to kill Shyam Lal. But, aunts Amravati and Indravati saw him. So, that's why he killed both of them. Meanwhile, the post-mortem report stated hemorrhagic shock as the cause of death for all three. 5 bones of Shyam Lal's head were found broken. Had gone to meet his girlfriend three days ago Himanshu is a resident of Kukarkatwa village, under the Meja police station area. During police interrogation, Himanshu stated- My girlfriend had been at her maternal uncle's house in Rajapur village for 4 months. We used to talk on the phone. One day, she asked me to meet her. I reached to meet her on June 13. Both of us met outside the village. My girlfriend said that if we want to get married, then uncle will have to be eliminated. As long as Uncle Shyam Lal is there, he will not let the marriage happen. He will object every time. So you kill him. Only after this will our path be clear. After this, Himanshu shared the plan with his friends living in the village. He said- I only went to kill Shyam Lal Himanshu said- Around 2:30 AM on the night of June 15 (Monday), I reached the village with my two friends, Nihal Gautam and Rajan Yadav. We had sticks and batons in our hands. I approached Shyam Lal, who was sleeping on a cot outside the house. I started striking his head repeatedly. During the attack, Shyam Lal screamed. Hearing the sound, Aunt Amravati, who was sleeping nearby, woke up. She started running while screaming. To prevent us from being identified, I hit her on the head from behind with a stick. With a single blow, Amravati fell to the ground, bleeding profusely. As we were fleeing from there, Aunt Indravati suddenly appeared in front of us. We also beat her to death with sticks. I didn't know that both aunts would die. I had only gone to kill Shyam Lal. DCP said - don't believe the accused's words DCP Yamunanagar Vivek Chandra Yadav said - The accused has revealed many things during interrogation, but their confirmation is still pending. Police are verifying his statements through surveillance and technical investigation. The CDR, location, and other electronic evidence from the mobile are being analysed. The role of the girl (girlfriend) will only become clear after the investigation is complete. Meanwhile, the post-mortem of all three bodies was conducted by a panel of 2 doctors on June 16. Videography was also done. According to the report, 5 bones in Shyam Lal's head were broken. Amravati and Indravati each had one deep injury on their heads. After the post-mortem, all three bodies reached home around 8 PM. During this time, police forces from Meja, Manda, Koraon, and Karchhana police stations were present at the spot. The last rites of all three bodies will be performed on Wednesday morning. Accused snatched inspector's pistol and fled, shot in the leg DCP Yamunanagar Vivek Chandra Yadav said - After Himanshu Yadav's arrest, the police took him to Paranipur village at night to recover the murder weapon. Here, while getting out of the police vehicle, Himanshu Yadav snatched a pistol from an inspector. Showing the pistol, he started to flee. When the police chased him, he opened fire. The policemen narrowly escaped. In a retaliatory firing by the police, Himanshu Yadav was shot in his left leg. He was injured by this. Police have admitted him to the district hospital. Now read the full case Shyamlal Gupta alias Kallu (65), a resident of Kukarkatwa village, used to run a small grocery shop at home. He was the eldest of 5 brothers. His two brothers, Dudhnath and Dhaniram, had died due to illness. His brother Nimbu Lal and son sell golgappas in Bengaluru, while Ram Niranjan works as a labourer in Rajasthan. Shyamlal had no children. He lived in the village with his wife, Saraswati. Dudhnath's wife, Indravati (55) and Nimbu Lal's wife, Amravati (58), also lived here. Dhaniram's wife lived with her 2 daughters, Priya alias Neha (19) and Shivani (8). Around 5 AM on June 16 (Tuesday), the bodies of Shyam Lal and his two brothers' wives, Amravati and Indravati, were found lying outside the house. All the bodies were covered in blood. Villagers informed the police. Upon receiving the information, the police, the dog squad, and the SOG team reached the spot. The tracker dog stopped after reaching the house of a suspect about 200 meters away. The forensic team collected fingerprints and other evidence from the crime scene. On Tuesday evening, police arrested 5 people, including the main accused, Himanshu. Sub-inspector posted at the outpost suspended for negligence The family alleges that in February, their daughter ran away from home with Himanshu. They were constantly receiving threats from those people. Regarding this, the family had filed a complaint at the police outpost as well as on the IGRS portal, but no action was taken. It is alleged that Sub-inspector Ramvilas Singh, posted at the outpost, had written in the investigation report that the applicant could not be contacted. Upon negligence coming to light in the matter, Sub-inspector Ramvilas Singh was suspended.

stories.title: Sant equates Ram Mandir frauds to insects:Alleges they abandoned Ayodhya’s decorum; demands resignation of trust officials
stories.summary: The alleged theft of temple offerings from the Ram Temple has triggered strong reactions from saints and religious leaders across the country. They say Ayodhya is the city of Shri Ram, who even sacrificed Sita Mata to uphold propriety and public duty. They questioned how offerings worth crores of rupees could allegedly be stolen without any trust official accepting responsibility or offering to resign. Kathavachak Devaki Nandan Thakur said that scriptures mention severe consequences for those who misuse temple wealth. He claimed that anyone involved in such an act would eventually be exposed. Meanwhile, the Special Investigation Team (SIT) has been conducting an inquiry inside Karsevakpuram for the past three days. According to reports circulating in Ayodhya, more than ₹2 crore in cash has allegedly been recovered from six individuals. There are also claims that offerings worth over ₹200 crore may have been misappropriated. However, the investigation is still underway, and officials have not yet confirmed the final amount involved. Kathavachak Devkinandan Thakur said, 'The case of theft of donations from the Ram Temple in Ayodhya is the most tragic incident to date. The Ram Temple was built 2 years ago, and now such a case has come to light. That is why we are advocating for the Sanatan Board. Then think, involving government officials in the Ram Temple is not right. This means that whoever consumes the wealth of the temple will become a worm in excrement for 60 thousand years. Our only demand is that a Sanatan Board be formed, and there should be no government interference in religious matters. So that the arrangements can be better for God and His devotees.' The Ram Temple was built in Ayodhya. Then, the first Ramkatha was narrated by Acharya Shantanu Ji Maharaj. Now, regarding the incident of offerings being stolen, he says, 'Ayodhya is the city of Shri Ram. Ram's entire life exemplifies dignity. He renounced his wife Sita after hearing the words of a washerman. Now, those who have been accused should resign from their positions. As long as the investigation is ongoing, these people should remove themselves from the trust.' Shantanu Ji says, 'This position was not even created for prestige. It was for the service of Ram Ji. But now there has been a betrayal. I am personally disappointed. I narrate Ramkatha, but after this incident, my heart is not in it. It's not just me; all saints are upset. We have to stay within our limits under the Constitution. Otherwise, those who stole from Ramji's temple should also receive social punishment. This theft is not of money, gold, or silver, but of the devotees' trust. Thousands of Ram devotees sacrificed, and then the temple was built. Now such a revelation is happening.' Shantanu says, 'Anyone was hired for the job. Those who are getting 18-20 thousand rupees, their lives are changing in 3-4 months. It's not like the people involved in the trust wouldn't have seen all this. This is not a Ram temple, it's a national temple. You cannot compare it with other temples. A very long sacrifice was made for this. Only then was it achieved.' Mahamandaleshwar Himangi Sakhi of Kinnar Akhara says, 'The entire life of Lord Shri Ram describes only decorum. Those who are in the trust should also show decorum and step down. Trust's General Secretary Champat Rai should be properly investigated. All those who are with him in the trust, and those whose names have come forward as note counters, should all be investigated. This entire trust should be dissolved and a new trust should be formed.' She further says, ‘Earlier kings and emperors used to make people from the Kinnar community treasurers. Because people from the Kinnar community did not have greed. Now there are 4 akharas of the Kinnar community. One member from each akhara should be included in the Ram Temple trust.’ Madan Ji Maharaj says, 'SIT should investigate against those people in whose possession the money from the Ram Temple offerings was found. The extent to which the trust members are involved should also come to light. This is a matter of trust for crores of people across the country. Devotees never want some people to fill their coffers with their money. They want their donated money to be used for welfare work in society.' Rupendra Prakash Shastri says, 'I don't think Champat Rai would have a role in the irregularities that have occurred in the offerings of the Ram Temple. However, we cannot say anything about his driver and relatives. The investigation is currently underway. The facts will come to light. It would not be appropriate to comment before that.' Ravindra Puri says, 'There are elections ahead, which is why such allegations are being made. Some people want to defame saints and the Ram Temple. An investigation is currently underway, after which things will become clear. Champat Rai is a very saintly person. We have seen his life. It is not appropriate to defame him.'

stories.title: Yogi warns against show of strength during Muharram:Action to be taken against disturbers; 50% bus fare concession for NEET aspirants
stories.summary: CM Yogi Adityanath has announced relief for candidates appearing in the NEET examination on June 21. NEET aspirants will get a 50 per cent discount on UP Roadways bus fares by showing their admit cards. The announcement was made during a video conference on Tuesday evening, where the Chief Minister reviewed the state's law and order situation, preparations for upcoming festivals. He directed all District Magistrates and Superintendents of Police to hold discussions in advance regarding Muharram. The Chief Minister said Muharram is a period of mourning and not an occasion for displaying strength. He ordered a ban on the display of weapons, the introduction of new traditions, loud DJs, and high-volume drums during the observance. He warned that strict action would be taken against anyone trying to disturb peace and harmony. CM Yogi also reviewed preparations for International Yoga Day. He said yoga programmes will be organised in 57,000 gram panchayats and 762 urban local bodies across the state, with public representatives participating in the events. A special cleanliness drive will be carried out on June 20, while mass yoga sessions will be held at Amrit Sarovars and historical sites on June 21. The Chief Minister further instructed officials to give priority to public grievance programmes, including Janata Darshan and Jansunwai. He also directed that districts without Chief Medical Officers should have appointments made within the next three days. Know the major points of the meeting 1. Instructions to officials to remain vigilant regarding Muharram During Muharram, the height of the Tazia will have to be kept according to the prescribed standards. Tazias taller than 10 to 12 feet will not be allowed. The CM said that the sentiments of all religions and people should be respected, but tampering with law and order or starting any new tradition will not be allowed. All District Magistrates and Superintendents of Police were instructed to prepare in advance to maintain peace and law and order during Muharram. Officials were asked to communicate with local people. Ensure that processions are completed peacefully. 2. Major events to be held across the state on International Yoga Day The CM reviewed the preparations for Yoga Day. He said that Yoga is an important heritage of Indian culture and the Rishi tradition. This year, International Yoga Day will be celebrated on the theme 'Yoga for Healthy Ageing'. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's program will be broadcast live across the state. Yoga programs will be organised in all 58 thousand gram panchayats and 762 urban local bodies. Mass yoga practice will be conducted at Amrit Sarovars, historical and cultural sites. Volunteers from voluntary organisations, yoga institutions, NCC, Scout-Guide, and NSS will also be included in this program. Instructions were given to run a special cleanliness drive on June 20 and to clean the program venues. 3. Action will be taken against officials for negligence in public grievances The Chief Minister also reviewed the complaints received on CM Helpline, Janta Darshan, and the IGRS portal. He said that the status of complaint resolution in some districts is not satisfactory. Improvements should be made soon in such districts. Action will be taken against officials who show negligence in complaints. Instructions were given to appoint Chief Medical Officers (CMOs) within three days in districts where they are not posted. It was stated that officials in the field should be deployed based on qualification and merit.

stories.title: Haryanvi dancer furious after Instagram account disabled:Alleges conspiracy by UP Police, accused youth; claims death threats
stories.summary: The Instagram account of a Haryanvi dancer who was allegedly molested during a stage show in Uttar Pradesh’s Hathras has been disabled. The dancer has accused UP Police and the youth accused of touching her waist of being behind the move. She claimed her social media account was deliberately shut down as part of a conspiracy to silence her voice. Angry over the police action, the dancer also released a video in which she appeared visibly upset. According to her, she was attending a live programme when she checked her phone and found that her Instagram account had suddenly disappeared. Despite repeated attempts, the account has not yet been restored. During the video, she also made a controversial statement. She said that if police do not take effective action against the accused youth and fail to treat the molestation case seriously, she would like to see what action police take if a similar incident happens to a girl from the accused’s own family. She questioned why the laws and provisions that are not being applied in her case would be enforced in any other case. The dancer further said that she would not end this fight under any circumstances and would continue her struggle for justice till her last breath. Meanwhile, UP Police has termed her allegations baseless and said action is being taken as per the law. 2 PHOTOS of harassment with Haryanvi dancer The Haryanvi dancer said these things in the video Dancer makes fresh allegations in video The Haryanvi dancer said she had been continuously using social media to put her side of the story before the public. She alleged that the accused youth, in collusion with the UP Police administration, got her Instagram account disabled so that she could no longer reach people through the platform. She claimed a major conspiracy was being hatched against her. While she said she did not know how many people were involved, she alleged that continuous efforts were being made to weaken and silence her. She made it clear that she would not back down under any pressure. Claims of receiving death threats The dancer also alleged that she has been receiving repeated death threats. According to her, some people uploaded videos on social media claiming they were standing outside her house and threatening to kill her. She said she would soon make those videos public as well. The dancer added that she was first molested and is now being threatened with death. She warned that if any further serious incident happens to her in future, the accused youth and the police administration would be responsible. Serious Questions Raised on Police Action The dancer said she was subjected to obscene behaviour and molestation on stage. She pointed out that a video of the incident exists and that many people witnessed what happened. Despite this, she alleged that police neither treated the matter seriously nor conducted a fair investigation. According to her, instead of arresting the main accused, police released a video claiming that three accused persons had been arrested. She maintained that there was only one main accused in the case — the youth who allegedly misbehaved with her on stage. ‘My voice won’t be silenced’ The dancer said anyone believing that she would go quiet after one social media account was disabled was mistaken. She stated that her other social media accounts remain active and that she would continue to put her side of the story before the public through every available platform. She warned that if she does not get justice from the government and administration, she may be forced to take a major step. A molestation case has been registered against the accused at Sasni Police Station in Hathras under Section 74 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) on the dancer’s complaint. Alleges weaker sections were imposed The dancer also said that whatever sections have been imposed against the youth by the Hathras police administration are not sufficient, they have been done merely as a formality so that the youth can escape. She said that the police have deliberately imposed such sections due to which the accused got bail from the police station itself. She has demanded that other sections should also be added in the molestation case.

stories.title: Do Ram Mandir devotees donate just ₹5 each?:Trust records show interest income surpassed donations in 11 months
stories.summary: Documents related to the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust suggest that the average devotee visiting the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya contributed only around ₹5 in donations, based on the trust’s reported figures for the past 11 months. The records also indicate that interest earned on the trust’s bank deposits exceeded the total donations received during the same period. In addition, questions have been raised over expenditure transparency, with some trust members reportedly claiming they were not provided with complete financial details during meetings. Trust members allege incomplete financial disclosure According to conversations with trust members and ex-officio office bearers, three key concerns were acknowledged: One example cited was the Dharmadhwaja installation ceremony, during which the trust reportedly spent more than ₹10 crore, but members said they were never given a detailed expenditure breakdown. Documents surfaced during donation box theft probe The financial records reportedly came to light during an investigation into the alleged theft of offerings from donation boxes inside the Ram Mandir complex. The documents are linked to a trust meeting held on March 21, 2026, and contain financial statements covering the period from April 1, 2025, to February 28, 2026. Sources associated with the Pilgrim Convenience Facility (PCF) said these were the same records shared with trust members during the meeting. Over ₹10 crore spent on Dharmadhwaja ceremony The Dharmadhwaja ceremony, held on November 25, 2025, was considerably smaller than the temple’s consecration event in January 2024 and primarily invited saints and religious leaders from different communities across Uttar Pradesh. The trust also arranged accommodation for outstation guests. Around 6,000 attendees participated in the event, including approximately 1,500 visitors from outside Ayodhya. According to the documents, the trust spent ₹10.12 crore on the ceremony—equivalent to an average expenditure of roughly ₹16,000 per attendee. However, members reportedly said they were not informed about the detailed allocation of these expenses. Temple received ₹83 crore in donations over 11 months The financial records state that the trust received approximately ₹83 crore in donations between April 2025 and February 2026. The reported sources include: During the same 11-month period, the temple reportedly witnessed around 160 million (16 crore) visitors. Based on these figures, the average donation per visitor works out to approximately ₹5, a calculation that investigators are reportedly examining as part of the ongoing inquiry. Interest income reached ₹138 crore The trust is also reported to have earned ₹138 crore in interest from funds deposited across four accounts maintained with SBI, PNB, and Bank of Baroda. Combined with the ₹83 crore in donations, the trust’s total reported income during the 11-month period amounted to approximately ₹221 crore. Now read where else and how much the trust spent in 11 months Security spending under scrutiny after alleged theft The documents indicate that the trust spent ₹10 crore on temple security during the same period, including CCTV surveillance systems and private security personnel. Questions have been raised over how thefts of donations and valuables could allegedly occur despite such expenditure. Reports claim that employee screening procedures were inadequate, allowing certain individuals to allegedly steal cash offerings and valuable ornaments. The article names Chandan Rai, nephew of trust general secretary Champat Rai, along with Ram Shankar alias Tinnu Yadav and Anukalp Mishra, in connection with the alleged theft allegations. Trust purchased 2 land parcels worth ₹26.69 crore The trust also acquired two properties during the reporting period: The combined cost of the two acquisitions stood at ₹26.69 crore.

stories.title: Hopes turn into ashes:Lucknow fire incident leaves 15 dead; VIDEO captures the tragedy
stories.summary: The devastating fire at a Lucknow coaching center not only destroyed a building but also the dreams of 15 families. In this inferno, 15 children lost their lives. Some lost their children, while others lost the support of their homes. As the fire spread, the children trapped inside tried everything to save their lives. Some climbed down by holding onto wires, while others tried to save their lives by jumping from the first floor. The fire brigade conducted a rescue operation by breaking down a wall. But when bodies emerged from amidst the smoke and flames, only screams and mourning remained at the scene. From the trauma center to the post-mortem house, the eyes of the relatives showed only the pain of losing their loved ones. In the end, only screams and the never-ending pain of losing loved ones remained.

stories.title: Weather changes across UP:Strong winds and rain lash 6 cities; monsoon likely within 3–4 days
stories.summary: The wait for the monsoon in UP is increasing. The monsoon has stalled after reaching the state's border. This has led to an increase in heat. People are suffering due to the humidity. Since Tuesday morning, most cities have experienced strong sunlight. The heat is palpable. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), the monsoon's entry into UP may take more than a week. For now, the heat will continue to show its intensity for a week. Today, there is an alert for rain in 16 cities and a heatwave in 38 cities. IMD states that usually, the monsoon enters UP by June 20. However, this time, after reaching the UP-Bihar border, the monsoon is unable to advance further. For the past 15 days, it has been stalled near Maharajganj. There are chances of it advancing today or tomorrow and reaching UP by June 28-29. In the last 24 hours, Prayagraj (43.3 °C) was the hottest city in the country. Gorakhpur, Siddharthnagar, Basti, Mau, Ghazipur, and Ballia received rain. In Basti, trees and poles were uprooted due to a storm and rain. A tree fell on a car. A unipole falling on the road caused heavy traffic jams. Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said- Currently, no weather system is active in UP, due to which heatwave conditions prevail in Eastern UP. The temperature will rise for the next one week. The Southwest Monsoon has advanced over South and Central India. It is likely to advance further in the next 48 hours. After this, a gradual increase in weather activities can also be seen in North India. How will the weather be in UP for the next 5 days? Know

stories.title: 10 coaching centres sealed in Indore:Administration takes action a day after Lucknow tragedy
stories.summary: Ten coaching centres and buildings were sealed in Indore on Tuesday, a day after 15 people were killed in the Lucknow coaching centre fire tragedy. One of the deceased in the Lucknow accident was software engineer Jayneel Chakraborty (26), a resident of Anuppur, Madhya Pradesh. A joint team of Indore administration, municipal corporation, and fire department raided several coaching institutes. Serious safety flaws were found at Catalyzer Coaching Center located in Geeta Bhawan. The building's emergency exit was closed. Nucleum Coaching Institute, Ramanujan Coaching Institute, Aayam Coaching Institute, Makhan Wala Hotel, and Ikrath Coaching Institute were also sealed. Inspection from Veda Business Park to Apollo Arcade The joint team inspected coaching centres as well as major commercial complexes in the city. During this, the fire safety arrangements of several commercial buildings in Veda Business Park, Apollo Avenue, Apollo Arcade, and Bhanwarkuan area were checked. The investigation found that fire-fighting systems in many buildings were faulty. They were not installed in accordance to the rules. In some places, regular maintenance of the fire safety system was not done. The administration issued notices to the building operators. Emergency exits found closed in multi-storey buildings During the inspection, emergency exits were found closed in several multi-storey buildings. In case of fire or other disaster, it is mandatory for such routes to be open and safe. Closed emergency gates can affect the safe evacuation of people. Inspection of coaching centres and libraries Under the leadership of SDM Ghanshyam Dhanger, the raids, dubbed 'operation coaching centre', was conducted. The raids are expected to continue. SDM Dhanger said action is also being taken against buildings where other commercial activities are being run along with coaching institutes and where adequate fire safety arrangements are not in place. Some restaurants, museums and other offices were also sealed. Officials said the safety of students is the top priority. They clarified that strict action will continue against negligent institutes and buildings. Relief will be granted upon implementing fire safety arrangements SDM Dhanger said the administration has clarified that the purpose of sealing is not to permanently close institutions, but to ensure compliance with safety regulations. Building operators will have to give an affidavit assuring that they will install necessary fire safety equipment and security arrangements within 15 to 20 days. Sealed buildings will reopen after submitting documents After the prescribed procedure is completed and safety standards are complied with, the concerned buildings and institutions be allowed to reopen.

stories.title: UP serial rapist killed in encounter:Abducted and raped 6 girls; had escaped from Punjab jail
stories.summary: In Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, police shot dead a 65-year-old serial rape accused during an encounter. The accused, Satpal alias Sattu, a resident of Punjab, had spent a total of 16 years in prison—11 years in Muzaffarnagar and 5 years in Ludhiana jail. He had escaped from Ludhiana jail in February 2026 and had been hiding in Muzaffarnagar and nearby districts since then. According to police, the encounter took place on Monday night around 11:30 pm when Sattu was apprehended after an exchange of fire. One bullet hit his leg and another struck above his waist. He was initially admitted to hospital, but his condition deteriorated on Tuesday and he died around 1 pm. Doctors said the cause of death was excessive blood loss. SSP Sanjay Verma stated that Satpal alias Sattu used to kidnap girls and rape them. He added that since February, the accused had allegedly targeted six victims. In one such case on June 19, he allegedly kidnapped a minor girl after luring her with a job offer and later raped her. Following the complaint, a case of kidnapping of a minor was registered at Civil Lines police station. Ten special police teams were formed, and a reward of ₹25,000 was announced for information leading to his arrest. Police teams from four states were also involved in the search operation. During the investigation, CCTV footage from around 1,000 cameras was examined and surveillance inputs helped trace his movements. Police said he had taken the victim to Punjab after kidnapping her, where she was kept captive and assaulted before being moved again via a bus route through Yamunanagar. This picture is from Monday night at 11:30 PM. Police arrested Sattu in the encounter. He was hit by two bullets. One above the waist and the other on the leg.Police claimed that Sattu had first fired at the police vehicle. One constable was injured in this. While another constable was injured during the encounter. SP explained how Sattu's encounter took place SP City Amrit Jain informed, “On Monday night at 11:25 PM, a joint team of police and SOG was conducting checking on Bamanhedi-Rudki Road. During this time, a suspicious car with a Punjab number plate was spotted. When police signaled it to stop, the driver started fleeing with the car. The police team chased the car and surrounded it.” “Upon this, the accused abandoned the car and started firing rapidly at the police team. This resulted in 2 constables getting injured. In the police's retaliatory firing, Sattu was hit by 2 bullets. He became seriously injured. He was admitted to the hospital,” he added. From the spot, police recovered a .32 bore pistol, cartridges, fake Aadhaar card, mobile phone, the car used in the crime, and gold earrings of the kidnapped girl. Sattu linked to Chhota Rajan gang, had over 24 cases in 3 states Police have identified the deceased accused Satpal alias Sattu as a member of the Chhota Rajan gang. According to officials, he was a resident of Ramdarbar Sector-32 in Chandigarh and his father’s name was Munnu Ram. Police said Sattu had been an active shooter and member of the notorious Chhota Rajan criminal network. Officials further stated that more than 24 cases are registered against him across three states, including serious charges such as murder, robbery, rape, and kidnapping.

stories.title: VIDEO | Alcohol, non-veg party on boat in Ganga:Five arrested in Varanasi, face up to 5 years in jail
stories.summary: Five boatmen have been arrested in Varanasi after a video allegedly showed them consuming beer, alcohol, and non-vegetarian food while on a boat in the Ganga River. The video, which was widely shared on social media, reportedly shows the men cooking chicken, drinking beer and liquor, and serving non-vegetarian food during the gathering. Case registered under BNS provisions Following the video's circulation, the Dashashwamedh police outpost in-charge filed a complaint, leading to a case under Sections 196 and 299 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), which relate to promoting enmity and acts allegedly hurting religious sentiments. Police arrested all five accused and seized the boat. They are expected to be produced before a court, and the offences may carry penalties of up to five years’ imprisonment, depending on the charges proved. See 2 pictures of the non-vegetarian party on the boat Police identify the accused The arrested individuals have been identified as Deepak Kumar, Ajay Sahni, Arun Kumar Sahni, Anurag Nishad, and Rahul Sahni. According to police, they are residents of Varanasi and nearby Ramnagar. Authorities said the video appears to have been recorded during the winter season, though its exact date is still being verified. Previous similar controversy Police also referred to an earlier incident in March, when an iftar gathering held on a boat in the Ganga drew controversy after videos circulated online showing non-vegetarian food being served. That incident led to a separate police case and multiple arrests after complaints from local groups.
