stories.title: 16-yr-old kills brother, sister-in-law and nephew:Accused says family made him quit studies, treated him like a dog
stories.summary: “I was very good at studies. I studied up to 5th grade in a CBSE school. I came first in class every time. After this, my father made me drop out of school. I somehow studied up to 10th grade by working as a laborer. I failed 10th grade due to lack of time. After this, my family members started taunting me even more. My family members collectively made me drop out of school. They used to insult me daily at home. Many days I didn't even get food. I had to search for a place to sleep in my own house.” This is what the 16-year-old accused boy, who murdered his elder brother, sister-in-law, and nephew in Bansgaon, Gorakhpur, said. After committing the crime around 3 am on Monday morning, he was sitting in a room on the second floor of the house. He had no remorse for committing the murder. He confessed during police interrogation, "I wanted to torture and kill my father in the same way." The police asked, "What will you do now?" Then he said, "I didn't get food at home, but in jail, my stomach will be full both times." Then the police asked, “What will you do after being released from jail?” He said, “Whatever fate has in store, that will happen.” Saying this, the accused started crying loudly. He kept repeating that he wanted to study, but he was not allowed to study. He had dreamt of becoming an officer by taking the UPSC exam. Accused says, “Dog died after eating home food.” The incident occurred on Monday at 3 AM in Balua village, under Bansgaon police station, 50 km from the district headquarters. The murdered were identified as Amit Gupta (35), his wife Ranjana (32), and son Reyansh. The police interrogated the accused for about two hours. During this, the accused stated that his family members always treated him like a dog. “Three years ago, my sister-in-law left food outside my room, just like for a dog. I took the food and threw it outside. A village dog ate that food. Shortly after, it died. Since then, I felt that there was a plan to kill me at home too. I worked hard in my father's carpentry shop, but I didn't get a single penny,” the accused said. “I used to call my elder sister and ask for money to recharge my mobile. I wore torn and old clothes; new clothes never came home for me. Many times, mutton was prepared from Tarkulha, but it was not served to me. The family members would eat it among themselves,” he said. Man demands death penalty for his son After losing their son, daughter-in-law, and grandson, father Harilal and mother Anita Devi are inconsolable. Harilal, weeping, demanded Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to ensure his son is sentenced to death at any cost. “My younger son killed his elder brother, sister-in-law, and three-year-old grandson while they were sleeping, using a gym rod and a cleaver at night,” the father said. “My younger son was asking for money, which led to disputes many times. If he had to kill someone, he should have killed me; what wrong did my elder son do to him? I have cancer, and my wife is undergoing treatment for her heart condition,” he said. "In such a situation, I was unable to provide money. He didn't understand this at all. He was only concerned about himself. He had no concern for his family," he added. Meanwhile, mother Anita Devi was unable to stay conscious after the remembering the incident. Anita said, "May God never give such a child to anyone; he destroyed the entire family." Amit had adopted his sister's daughter People in Balua village are shocked by the actions of this 'Kalyugi' son (a son of the Kali Yuga, implying evil/unrighteous). Ramsajeevan, from the village, said Amit was very friendly. He was married 15 years ago. He did not have children of his own, following which he adopted his younger sister's child. Her age is now 9 years. Meanwhile, three years ago, after receiving medical treatment, his wife gave birth to a son. The little child used to play outside the house; everyone in the locality loved the child. The accused killed Amit, his wife, and son, but did not kill the adopted niece. The young girl said that her uncle first killed her father, then cut off her mother's and baby's heads. She immediately ran away screaming, and told everything to her grandmother. “I kept saying repeatedly - don't kill my baby, in one swift stroke, he cut off his and my mother's heads,” the girl said. Head crushed with a rod, then throats slit with a cleaver The bodies of Amit Gupta, his wife Ranjana, and their son Reyansh were sent for post-mortem at BRD Medical College. The post-mortem report stated that severe injuries were present in the head and neck which caused the deaths. Amit's head was attacked seven to eight times with a rod. Ranjana's head was hit twice, and Reyansh's throat was slit. According to the police, the accused was most angry with his father and elder brother. Therefore, he repeatedly hit his elder brother's head with a gym rod. He wanted to torture him to death. The younger son had fought with his father, a compromise was reached at the police station. Father Harilal has filed a complaint against his accused younger son. Harilal said that he had a carpenter's shop a short distance from home in the town. The elder son, Amit, used to do paint and polish work outside. Two years ago, he started sitting at the shop. This made the younger son unhappy. Two months ago, there was also a dispute between the father and the younger son. The younger son was asking his father for ₹5 lakh to start work. After this, a compromise was reached at the police station. The younger son used to come home drunk and caused disputes almost daily. Psychiatrists says such activity is called psychopathic. Psychiatrist Dr. Amit Kumar Shahi said, “This type of activity is called psychopathic behavior. It can be due to many reasons. Sometimes social ups and downs mentally disturb people, making them feel inferior. People related to them often misinterpret things.”

stories.title: Kanpur seals over 30 coaching centres after fire:KDA cracks down on institutes violating building and fire safety regulations
stories.summary: Following the deadly fire at a coaching centre in Lucknow, the Kanpur Development Authority (KDA) has launched a large-scale inspection drive in Kakadeo, one of Uttar Pradesh’s biggest coaching hubs. More than 30 coaching institutes have been sealed for allegedly violating building and fire safety norms. Many were reportedly operating commercial activities from residential buildings without complying with mandatory regulations. Inspection teams check every building Acting on the state government's directions, KDA formed four special teams to inspect coaching centres across the area. Officials have been examining buildings one by one since Tuesday morning. While 16 institutes were sealed by Monday night, the number rose to over 30 by Tuesday afternoon. Focus on student safety KDA Secretary Abhay Pandey said the action was taken to prevent incidents similar to the Lucknow tragedy, as thousands of students study in Kakadeo every year. He said authorities are inspecting coaching centres and other commercial establishments to ensure they meet safety standards. Fire safety and basements under scrutiny The inspection is focusing on buildings lacking adequate fire safety measures, emergency exits, or those operating from basements without approved plans. Authorities warned that any institution found violating construction, usage, or fire safety regulations would face sealing and legal action under relevant laws. Similar drive conducted earlier KDA officials said this is not the first such campaign. Around six months ago, a special drive led to the sealing of more than 100 basements and coaching institutes for similar violations. The current campaign has been expanded, with teams instructed to inspect every street and building in the area to ensure compliance with safety norms.

stories.title: Fire breaks out at coaching centre in Agra:Students rush onto street from second floor; another incident reported after Lucknow
stories.summary: Within 24 hours of the deadly fire in Lucknow that claimed 15 lives, another fire scare unfolded at a coaching centre in Agra on Tuesday. Smoke reportedly billowed from the basement following a suspected short circuit, prompting the swift evacuation of more than 100 students attending classes. According to eyewitnesses, smoke suddenly began rising from the basement, after which the coaching management immediately ordered all classrooms to be evacuated. Students were escorted out in an orderly manner, while local residents rushed to the spot. The incident triggered brief panic in the area, though no injuries were reported. Police and fire officials inspect premises After receiving information about the fire, police and fire brigade officials reached Akash Coaching Centre and inspected the premises. Authorities found that the institute had adequate fire safety arrangements in place. However, during an inspection of GS Coaching Centre nearby, officials identified serious safety deficiencies. They noted that the entry and exit passages were extremely narrow and several fire extinguishers were found to be empty. The administration issued a stern warning, directing the coaching management to immediately improve safety measures or vacate the premises. Both the coaching operator and the building owner were summoned by the police. See 2 pictures... Student: ‘Teachers told us to leave the classroom immediately’ Student Poonam said she was attending a botany class when staff members and teachers suddenly entered and instructed everyone to leave the classroom without delay. “We weren’t given any information at first. Our teachers asked us to move out quickly and led us outside in lines. We initially thought the classes had been dismissed or that something important had come up,” she said. “Later, we were informed that a transformer in the ground-level area had caught fire. That was all we knew.” ‘About 50 students were in our classroom’ Another student, Aryan Pandit, said around 50 students were present in his classroom when the evacuation began. “Our teachers came in and told us there was a fire. We immediately exited through the fire escape and saw many students already outside,” he said. “There wasn’t much panic because we couldn’t see smoke inside the classroom. We only knew that a fire had broken out somewhere in the building. The teachers ensured that everyone was evacuated quickly.”

stories.title: ‘Save us’ calls haunt families after Lucknow fire:Father faints on seeing son’s body, sister breaks down in tears
stories.summary: The bodies of all 15 victims who died in the Lucknow coaching centre fire underwent post-mortem examinations over nearly seven hours on Monday night. After the process was completed, the bodies were handed over to their families. Scenes outside the mortuary were heartbreaking. One father reportedly fainted after seeing his son’s body, while grieving relatives broke down in tears. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to 6 family members. They said that after being trapped in the fire, the children called home, informed them about the fire, and pleaded for help to save their lives. But, by the time we arrived, it was too late. Many victims made last calls for help According to family members, several victims managed to call their loved ones after becoming trapped inside the burning building. They informed them about the fire and pleaded for help, but rescue could not reach them in time. See 5 pictures- Read the pain of the families of 5 people who lost their lives in the accident Abdul Rehman supported his family Abdul Rehman, an IT technician from Lucknow, had recently secured a job after a long wait. Friends said he had started working at a young age to support his family, as his father was paralysed. His family said he called home after getting trapped in the fire. His parents were too distressed to visit the mortuary immediately. Sukhmani Singh tried to escape Sukhmani Singh’s father said his son called around 2:30 PM, saying, “Papa, there is a fire. Please save us.” Relatives said Sukhmani had left for work happily that morning and had planned to spend the evening with his family before the tragedy struck. Aditya’s sister missed his final call Aditya Srivastava, a 3D character artist from Sitapur, also lost his life in the blaze. His sister said he had called her while trapped inside the building, but she was unable to answer. According to the family, several people took shelter inside a bathroom hoping to survive the fire, while another relative escaped by jumping from a window. Mother collapses after seeing daughter’s body The family of Anamika, who worked as an animation artist in Lucknow, travelled from Kolkata to collect her body. Her mother collapsed in grief after seeing her daughter, while relatives recalled that Anamika had spoken to them normally before leaving for work on the day of the incident. Marriage plans ended in tragedy Twenty-one-year-old Nilesh, another victim of the fire, was reportedly planning to marry his colleague Anamika. According to family members, both families had begun discussing the match and were preparing to meet soon. The plans were cut short by the devastating fire, leaving both families in mourning.

stories.title: Ram Mandir donation theft probe report submitted:SIT recommends FIR, five-year audit trust restructuring measures suggested
stories.summary: The Special Investigation Team (SIT) on Tuesday submitted its investigation report to the Uttar Pradesh government in the alleged Ram Mandir donation theft case. According to media reports, the SIT report recommends registering an FIR in the matter, reconstituting the temple trust, and appointing a senior official as the temple's Chief Executive Officer (CEO). The SIT has also sought additional time for a more detailed investigation, and has claimed that the submitted report is an initial one. The 150-page preliminary report was submitted to Sanjay Prasad, Additional Chief Secretary of the Home Department. The SIT stated that the report includes details of the questioning of 150 individuals. According to sources, the SIT has recommended an audit of the temple's donations over the past five years. It has also proposed measures to prevent irregularities in the handling of donations and raised questions about the role of certain office-bearers of the temple trust. Sources further said that the state government will forward the report to the Union Ministry of Home Affairs, which will decide whether any members of the trust should be retained or removed. In the Ram Temple theft case, investigators have recovered ₹2 crore based on information provided by five accused—Lavkush, Avneesh, Anukalp, Karune, and Ramshankar alias Tinnu. Gold was also recovered from the residence of Tinnu, who is considered a close associate of Champat Rai, a key member of the Ram Mandir trust. According to preliminary estimates, the alleged theft could exceed ₹200 crore.

stories.title: Lucknow building to be razed:48 coaching centres sealed in UP; Akhilesh Yadav seeks ₹1 crore aid for victims' families
stories.summary: A total of 15 people have died in the fire at a two-storey building in Lucknow. On Tuesday morning at 11 am, the Special Investigation Team (SIT) and a forensic team reached the site to investigate the tragedy. The team inspected the building, and the SIT, which includes IPS officer Praveen Kumar and IAS officer Amrit Abhijat, collected evidence and left with bags containing material from the scene. The post-mortem examinations lasted for seven hours before the bodies were handed over to their families. The mother of 30-year-old Anamika from West Bengal collapsed after seeing her daughter's body at the post-mortem house. The investigation has revealed that the building where the fire broke out was illegal. A demolition order had been issued in 2016 but was later cancelled. Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) Vice-Chairman Prathamesh Kumar said the building owner has been served a notice and asked to respond within 15 days. He added that the building will be demolished. The building belongs to Virendra Shukla, owner of Rameshwaram Institute of Technology and Management College. Police have registered a case of culpable homicide not amounting to murder and arrested four accused, including Virendra. stories.title: Ayodhya DM assumes charge of Ram Mandir administration:Three major changes introduced, donation counting process overhauled
stories.summary: The investigation into the alleged misappropriation of donations at the Ayodhya Ram Mandir has reached its final stages, with the Special Investigation Team (SIT) completing its preliminary probe and preparing its report under the leadership of SIT chief Vijay Vishwas Pant. Given the religious significance of the case and its impact on millions of devotees, the report will first be submitted to the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO). Only after receiving approval is legal action expected to begin. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is reportedly monitoring developments in the matter. Ayodhya DM oversees Ram Mandir operations Amid the ongoing investigation, Ayodhya District Magistrate Shashank Tripathi, who serves as an ex-officio member of the Ram Mandir Trust, has assumed oversight of the temple’s day-to-day administration. According to the report, trust members who previously handled operational decisions are no longer actively involved in routine management Three major changes introduced in donation management Following the launch of the investigation, temple authorities have significantly tightened procedures related to donation handling and staff supervision. 1. Cash counting shifted to floor-based process Previously, volunteers counted donation box cash while seated at tables and chairs. The process has now been shifted to floor mats and carpets, with strict frisking of staff before and after counting sessions. Video recording of cash removal from donation boxes has also been made mandatory. 2. Staff replaced and surveillance strengthened Only 40 trusted volunteers have been assigned to count donations. Earlier personnel, along with two bank employees involved in the process, have reportedly been replaced. Six new CCTV cameras have been installed, and digital video storage capacity is being expanded. 3. Trustees’ operational powers frozen Trust General Secretary Champat Rai, trustee Dr. Anil Mishra, and invited member Gopal Rao are no longer participating in routine administrative decisions and are reportedly barred from making fresh operational decisions related to temple management. Administrative supervision is currently being carried out under the District Magistrate’s oversight. Key trust officials keeping low profile According to sources cited in the report, Champat Rai, who earlier resided at Karsevakpuram, has been staying within the Ram Mandir complex since the donation controversy surfaced and has not been leaving the premises. Dr. Anil Mishra reportedly visits the temple daily before returning to his residence in Lakshmanpuri Colony, while Gopal Rao, who lives adjacent to the temple complex, continues to visit regularly. Employees from whose residences cash was allegedly recovered are reportedly being kept in a basement inside the temple premises, where police and officials are conducting questioning. SIT report divided into 3 sections The Special Investigation Team has structured its findings into three major components: Criminal investigation The probe examines whether negligence or misconduct by employees or trustees resulted in the disappearance of cash donations, jewellery, or other temple assets. Financial audit Investigators have reviewed donations received so far, banking transactions, tender procedures, and land purchase and sale records associated with the temple trust. Reform recommendations The SIT is expected to recommend changes to trust regulations, improved security mechanisms, and enhanced accountability measures to prevent similar incidents in the future. Trustees may be removed from responsibilities According to sources, senior trust functionaries, including Champat Rai, Dr. Anil Mishra, and Gopal Rao, are unlikely to receive a clean chit in the investigation. While they may not face direct allegations of theft, they could be held accountable for negligence and administrative lapses. The report further claims that discussions between the government and the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) have resulted in a broad consensus to gradually remove the three individuals from trust responsibilities in the coming period. FIRs and arrests likely after final report With public scrutiny and political attention focused on the alleged donation irregularities, authorities are expected to adopt a zero-tolerance approach. The preliminary report has already been completed, while the final report is expected within 15 days. Once submitted, the Ram Mandir Trust may file formal complaints leading to FIRs against those found responsible. Several temple employees, including Anukalp Mishra, Somesh Anand, Ramshankar Yadav (Tinnu), D.K. Tiwari, Manish Yadav, Lavkush Mishra, Rajesh Pathak, and contractual workers Ratnesh Chaturvedi and Gagandeep Singh, are reportedly under investigation over allegations related to recovered cash or irregularities in donation counting. Any arrests or legal proceedings will depend on the conclusions of the final investigation.

stories.title: Automatic gate malfunction in Lucknow coaching claims 15 lives:Only one staircase for entry and exit; residential building was converted to commercial
stories.summary: The Lucknow coaching centre fire incident claimed 15 lives. Most of the deceased were students who came to learn gaming and animation. At the time of the incident, all students were in class after lunch. Initial investigation has revealed that the building had only one exit route from the outside. The main gate of the coaching centre was also automatic. It opened and closed through thumb impression. A student said that due to the fire, the thumb impression-based gate got locked, trapping most of the students inside. There was no alternative emergency exit. Within a few minutes of the fire breaking out, the entire building was filled with smoke. At the time of the incident, around 30 students and staff members were inside. While 8–10 students managed to escape using internet, DTH cables and pipes, 3–4 students jumped down from the second floor. Around 5–6 injured students are still admitted in KGMU. The building belongs to the owner of Rameshwaram Engineering College The building where the fire broke out is constructed on land owned by Virendra Shukla. Virendra Shukla is the owner of Rameshwaram Engineering College. The college is known as Rameshwaram Institute of Technology and Management (RITM), established in 2008. The college is affiliated with Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) and is approved by AICTE. Investigation has revealed that the building map was passed in the name of Dhirendra and Surendra Shukla. Initially it was a residential building, but in 2014 it was approved for commercial use. An online animation and gaming coaching centre was running in the building. Due to summer vacations, a large number of students had enrolled here. After the incident, the administration has started an investigation into the role of the then officials and engineers. A list of 16 people has been prepared against whom action will be taken. Biometric system got locked due to fire An injured student’s friend, Yash, said that there was only one entry-exit point to go up and down. A biometric system was installed there. During the fire, the biometric system stopped working, due to which the children inside could not open the gate in time. The investigation has revealed that there was only one entry and exit route in the building. There was also only one staircase for movement. There was no alternative emergency exit. Even the door leading to the roof was locked. This is why many students could not escape in time amid smoke and chaos. Fire broke out due to explosion in AC compressor Initial investigation suggests that the fire may have started after a blast in the split AC compressor installed in the building. The spark from it spread to nearby items and furniture, causing the fire to engulf the entire building within minutes. Officials also believe that a short circuit could be a possible reason. However, the exact cause will be known only after the forensic and technical investigation reports are received. At present, agencies are examining all possible causes. Children tried to save themselves by locking themselves in the bathroom After the fire broke out, smoke first spread on the lower floors and then rapidly moved upwards. People on the upper floors panicked due to the sudden incident. Many tried to rush outside. Some locked themselves in rooms and bathrooms. There was chaos and screaming inside. Condition worsened due to suffocation According to fire officials, after the fire broke out, thick smoke filled the building quickly. Due to this, students and others inside could not find their way out. Some students hid in bathrooms while others moved into store rooms to save themselves. However, due to dense smoke and heat, many became unconscious. When the rescue team entered, several people were found unconscious. Fire officials said that the staircase leading to the roof was locked, preventing students from reaching a safe exit. To escape the smoke, they kept trying to hide in different parts of the building. First fire brigade vehicle reached 8 minutes after receiving information According to the fire department, the information about the fire was received at the control room at 2:27 pm. The first fire brigade vehicle reached the spot within just 8 minutes, followed by additional fire tenders, hydraulic platforms, and SDRF and NDRF teams for rescue operations. Rescue teams entered by breaking the rear wall Considering the severity of the fire, fire services, SDRF, and NDRF teams broke the rear wall of the building to enter inside. After that, rescue operations were carried out amid smoke and debris. According to officials, an attempt was made to enter by breaking a nearly 9-inch thick rear wall of the building. However, due to its strength, it took time to break, delaying access to unconscious students and others. Preliminary information suggests that plastic and aluminium sheet partitions and interior work were used in the office. This caused the fire to spread rapidly. A pet shop located on the ground floor had pedigree, packaging material, and other plastic products, which further accelerated the fire. According to rescue personnel, three types of chemicals used for pet treatment and care were also stored in the pet shop and clinic. After the fire, the smoke became highly toxic, affecting students on the upper floors first. Many became unconscious due to suffocation and toxic fumes within minutes. 15 cats were also inside, survived amidst the smoke Firefighters said that around 15 cats were present on the premises. Despite being exposed to smoke for a long time, they survived due to their biological resilience, whereas humans were affected much faster by the toxic fumes. A police officer rescued a cat from the fire and carried it out in his arms. Why did the fire spread so rapidly?

stories.title: 2 suspected terrorists are held over blast plot:Paste Pakistani don's posters across UP; receive target to survey Army and Air Force locations
stories.summary: UP ATS (Anti-Terrorist Squad) arrested 2 suspected terrorists on Thursday. One is named Mohammad Umar and the other is Faizan. Both are residents of Bulandshahr. ATS claims that both were in contact with a terrorist network linked to the Pakistani intelligence agency ISI and Pakistani gangsters. Both were given the target of reconnoitring Lucknow Army Cantt and Bamrauli Air Force Station in Prayagraj. In return, they were promised 10 thousand rupees. ADG Law and Order Amitabh Yash said that a total of 15 people have been arrested in this case so far. ATS is engaged in further investigation. Posters and videos of a Pakistani gangster found Amitabh Yash stated - Mohammad Umar and Faizan came into contact with Pakistani gangsters Shahzad Bhatti, Abid Jatt, Hammad Barkati, and Rana Hunain through WhatsApp and Instagram. At their behest, both were involved in anti-national activities. The investigation revealed that the accused were tasked with putting up posters of Pakistani don Abid Jatt in several areas of Bulandshahr and sending videos of them. In return, they were to receive 12 thousand rupees. According to ATS, the objective was to create an atmosphere of fear and terror among people. Both were also given the task of reconnaissance (gathering information) of sensitive locations like Lucknow Army Cantt and Bamrauli Air Force Station in Prayagraj. For this, they were promised 10 thousand rupees. ATS found Abid Jatt's posters, videos made while putting up the posters, and other digital evidence from the accused. Who is Shahzad Bhatti, who is creating sleeper cells in UP? Connection with Land Mafia and Underworld: Shehzad Bhatti is a notorious don from Pakistan. He lives in Dubai. Bhatti has connections with big gangsters of Pakistan's land mafia and underworld. Due to this, Pakistan had also imposed a ban on Shehzad Bhatti. In May 2025, Bhatti came to Pakistan after about 5 years. Farukh Khokhar's Right Hand, Network in Many Countries: Bhatti is the right hand of Pakistan's notorious mafia Farukh Khokhar and works for him. His network also operates in other countries including Europe, UK (United Kingdom), America, Canada, Pakistan, and Dubai. Manufactures Bombs and Smuggles Weapons: Shehzad Bhatti has a large network spread across the world for bomb and weapon smuggling. Be it any kind of weapon. Whether weapons are to be procured from China, America, or Russia for money. His network works from all sides. Criminals in India also get weapons from him: Many times, Bhatti uploads his photo videos with modern weapons. A large portion of his weapons is also sent to India. Many criminals in India procure weapons through Bhatti, which are brought into India from the Pakistan border. Fond of keeping lions: Shahzad Bhatti is also very fond of keeping lions. Whether he is living in Pakistan, or in Dubai and Europe. He and his associates have kept lions everywhere. Bhatti also shares videos and photos with his pet lions. Enmity with Lawrence after the Pahalgam attack Shahzad Bhatti previously worked with Lawrence Bishnoi. He had also provided weapons for the murder of Punjabi singer Sidhu Moosewala. His friendship with Lawrence became known when a video of him exchanging greetings with Lawrence on Eid went viral. However, after the Pahalgam terrorist attack, Lawrence threatened terrorist Hafiz Saeed. After this, Bhatti got enraged and started threatening Lawrence. This friendship further deteriorated when Bhatti started directly handling Lawrence's henchmen. He made them carry out grenade attacks on police stations in Punjab. Now both continue to threaten each other. How is he making youth pawns? On November 30, 2025, the Special Cell of Delhi Police arrested three youths associated with Shahzad Bhatti. Their age was between 19 and 23 years. Investigation revealed that all three were poor and less educated. They came into contact with Shahzad through social media, especially Instagram, and were used by luring them with money. According to agencies, Shahzad uses such youths as "disposable foot soldiers". In Uttar Pradesh, agencies have apprehended 15 suspected terrorists in the last two months. On April 4, 4 suspects were arrested from Lucknow. During ATS interrogation, it was revealed that they had an offer from Pakistan, ‘Spread terror, the more terror, the more money you will get’ In an attempt to carry out a major blast, the four suspected terrorists rehearsed by setting a pickup truck and a bike on fire. They had sent videos of this to Pakistani handler Abu Bakar. In return, they received 12 thousand rupees for each arson. Apprehension of activating sleeper cells at the behest of ISI: According to intelligence inputs, Shahzad Bhatti is now trying to reactivate dormant sleeper cells in India at the behest of ISI. From this angle, NIA and Intelligence Bureau are thoroughly investigating his activities.

stories.title: Raebareli man kills brother over affair with sister-in-law:Cuts off his nose and ears during attack; says he wants to stay with her
stories.summary: In Raebareli, a cousin murdered a watchman by cutting him with a 'banka' (a type of curved knife). First, he slit his throat, then cut off his nose and ears. He also inflicted several wounds on his face with the 'banka'. The brother had an illicit relationship with the watchman's wife. The watchman was becoming an obstacle in his way. Police have solved the case within 72 hours and arrested the accused. On the night of June 15 (Monday), the assailant arrived in the dark. He inflicted several wounds with a sharp weapon on Binda Prasad, who was sleeping on a cot. Binda died on the spot in the attack. On the morning of June 16, when villagers went towards the fields, they saw a blood-soaked body lying on the cot. Upon receiving information, forensic and police teams reached the spot. The body was sent for a post-mortem. The incident occurred in the Bachhrawan police station area. Now, know the full story in detail Thakurain Kheda village is about 29 kilometers away from the district headquarters. Here, Binda Prasad (45) lived with his wife and 2 children. He was working as a watchman in the water tank being built under the Jal Jeevan Mission. After dinner on Monday night, he went to sleep on a cot in the tank premises as usual. Just then, his cousin Rajkishore arrived there and hacked Binda to death with a 'banka' (a type of curved knife). Rajkishore had an illicit relationship with Binda's wife for about 3 years. Upon learning about this, Binda had scolded both of them. Since then, Rajkishore was looking for an opportunity to take revenge. During the investigation, the police scrutinized the call details of Binda and his family members' mobile numbers. Based on the clues found and suspicious activities, the police investigation reached Binda's cousin, Rajkishore. Upon being taken into custody and interrogated, Rajkishore confessed to the entire conspiracy and the crime of murder. During interrogation, Rajkishore revealed - I had an affair with Binda's wife for the past approximately 3 years. She is a mother of two children. I wanted to keep her with me, but my sister-in-law was not ready for it. I felt that Binda Prasad, my brother, was the biggest obstacle between me and my sister-in-law. For this reason, I hatched a conspiracy to murder Binda. I repeatedly struck the sleeping Binda on his head and body with a 'banka' (a type of curved knife/machete). After that, I fled from the scene. Weapon used in murder recovered, brother sent to jail Police also recovered the 'banka' (a type of curved knife) used in the murder based on Rajkishore's confession. Based on interrogation and evidence, a case was registered against Rajkishore and he was presented in court. From there, he was sent to jail. CO Maharajganj Pradeep Kumar said that preliminary investigation revealed a love affair as the main reason for the murder. Other aspects of the case are also being investigated.

stories.title: Shankaracharya gets clean chit in Rewa Express attack case:GRP's final report, says he is not behind attack on Ashutosh Maharaj
stories.summary: Another accusation made by Ashutosh Maharaj against Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand turned out to be false. The GRP has filed the final report regarding the alleged attack on the Rewa Express. In this, the allegations made against Avimukteshwaranand and his disciples have not been confirmed. The GRP investigation stated that sufficient evidence was not found to support the allegations of attack. Actually, on March 8, 2026, Ashutosh Brahmachari had accused himself of being attacked during a train journey. In the complaint, he had named Shankaracharya and some of his disciples. Ashutosh Brahmachari has expressed disagreement with the GRP's final report. He said that he would file a petition in court and demand an investigation by an independent agency. Meanwhile, Shankaracharya's media in-charge, Shailendra Yogiraj Sarkar, issued a press note on Thursday. In it, he stated that the allegations against Shankaracharya and his disciples were not confirmed in the investigation. Read, what Ashutosh Maharaj said Ashutosh Maharaj said- On March 8, a deadly attack was made on me in the Rewa Express. After this, in addition to GRP Prayagraj, I sent a complaint to the Union Home Secretary and other senior officials on March 10, demanding an impartial investigation. I had requested an investigation into CCTV footage, coach duty register, deployment of security personnel, passenger statements, and other important evidence in the complaint. The investigation of the case has not been fair. The investigation was closed without properly considering the available facts and my petitions. I will demand an investigation by an independent agency. Ashutosh said - GRP SP supported the other party Ashutosh Maharaj, alleging, said that the then GRP SP was biased towards the other party. A complaint about this had already been made to the concerned central authorities. He said that his aim is not to target any particular person, but to bring out the truth of the incident. Meanwhile, in this matter, GRP Superintendent of Police Prashant Kumar said - the investigation was conducted based on available evidence and facts. If the complainant has any objection, they can present their case before the supervisory officer. They can also avail the available legal process. 2 pictures of the attack on Ashutosh Now know what the matter was Ashutosh Maharaj was allegedly attacked on March 8, 2026, on the Rewa Express train. Ashutosh had alleged that he was attacked near Sirathu station at 5 AM on the Rewa Express train while travelling from Ghaziabad to Prayagraj. An unknown assailant had tried to cut his nose with a sharp weapon. In this case, a lawsuit was filed against Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand and his associates. Ashutosh Maharaj is a disciple of Jagadguru Rambhadracharya Ashutosh Maharaj was born into a Brahmin family in Kandhla town of Shamli. His father, Rajendra Pandey, was a conductor on private buses running on Delhi Road. Ashutosh Maharaj was associated with the committee of the ancient Shakumbhari Siddhpeeth Temple in Kandhla. Currently, he is also its manager. His uncle, Pradeep Pandey, from the same family, is a priest at the temple. In 2022, he took initiation from Jagadguru Rambhadracharya. Since then, he has been living a monastic life.

stories.title: Mohammad Salauddin allegedly maintains links with Pakistan:Suspicious chats and digital content recovered; allegedly draws youths towards Jihadi ideology
stories.summary: Contacts and chats with agents based in Pakistan have been found on the mobile phone of Mohammad Salauddin, a resident of Gadarpur in Udham Singh Nagar district. The Uttarakhand Special Task Force (STF) has arrested him after taking action. The STF is interrogating the accused. Additionally, weapons and explosive materials have also been recovered based on his information. According to the STF, the accused was trying to influence youths with Jihadi and radical ideologies. The accused has also been found involved in anti-national activities. The STF is investigating Mohammad Salauddin's international connections. Anti-national messages found on mobile STF SSP Ajay Singh said that Salauddin was continuously connected with people on various Telegram groups and Signal groups. He is connected with people sitting in Pakistan and Malaysia. Salauddin was taken into custody and his phone was checked. He was continuously connected to such groups to inspire people for anti-national activities and similar terrorist incidents. He was also secretly chatting with other people in the country in this manner. He was planning something big. Suspicious conversations related to the storage and movement of weapons and explosive materials have also come to light in the chats. Technical and forensic investigations are being conducted to confirm these facts. Circulated videos of terrorist organisations The accused, Mohammed Salauddin, was trying to influence youth with radical and jihadist ideologies using social media platforms like Instagram, Telegram, and Signal. Investigation of his mobile phone revealed several groups, chats, and digital content containing messages related to jihad, martyrdom, and anti-national ideas. He was also circulating videos of organizations like Jaish-e-Mohammed and Al-Qaeda in various places. Accused was in contact with a person from UP The SSP stated that according to the primary information received so far, one person had come from Telangana. He also gave some money to Mohammed Salauddin. The same person had also put Mohammed Salauddin in contact with other people on the Signal app. We are working on whatever concrete information has been received so far regarding that person. During interrogation, Mohammad Salauddin admitted to deleting some chats and contacts. The investigation also revealed his contact with a person residing in Rampur, Uttar Pradesh, regarding whom the STF team is conducting further investigation. 2 AK-47 cartridges recovered SSP Ajay Singh said that during a search operation conducted late at night, based on the accused's tip-off, a foreign pistol, five cartridges, four detonators, and two AK-47 cartridges were recovered. Considering the seriousness of the matter, a case has been registered against the accused under various sections of BNS (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita) and IT Act, and he has been arrested. SSP Ajay Singh stated that any activity affecting social harmony, national unity, and internal security will not be tolerated in Uttarakhand. It is appealed to the general public that if they receive information about any individual's suspicious or anti-national activities, they should immediately inform the police or STF. The identity of the informant will be kept completely confidential.

stories.title: Yogi launches ₹570 crore projects in Unnao:Says development grows under honest governments; family politics held UP back
stories.summary: CM Yogi said in Unnao on Thursday - Those who had turned the state into a mafia raj, who had made the state riot- and curfew-ridden, those people are not tired of giving sermons. There is no shame at all. Looking at their tenure, it will be known how deep water they were in. The CM said- Congress and SP were incompetent and corrupt. They only thought about their families. For them, the poor meant only two families. For Congress, the Nehru-Gandhi family, and for SP, the Saifai family. Beyond this, they could not even think about anyone else. If any poor person raised their voice, their voice was suppressed. The CM inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for 101 development projects worth 570 crore rupees. He said - the Annaprashan (first solid food ceremony) of two children was to be performed. MP Sakshi Maharaj told me that earlier the children were crying, but as soon as we reached in front of them, they stopped crying. Then I told him - children are symbols of God, those children know that we have arrived now. They are safe.Unnao MP Sakshi Maharaj was present on the stage with the CM. The CM distributed certificates to the beneficiaries.1- Earlier, SP-Congress goons used to wreak havocEarlier, if anyone raised their voice, SP-Congress goons and mafias would not only silence their voice but also kidnap traders and wreak complete havoc. When I see the deeds of these power-backed mafias, I remember the Ramayana. Just as there were Khara, Dushana, Maricha, and Subahu in the Ramayana era, there was mafia rule during the time of SP and Congress. Have you ever seen SP-Congress leaders shed tears for a poor person? No. Their tears flow for the mafia.2- UP's youth will never accept SP-CongressThese very people ruled the country for the longest time after independence, but both these parties are equally responsible for pushing the country and the state into the abyss of misery and bringing them to a crisis of identity. Therefore, when I see their dual character, it makes me laugh. The youth of UP will never accept those who played with the future of Uttar Pradesh's youth. Whenever they get a chance, they will surely take revenge for that insult. This is what the youth of UP has been doing for the last 14 years.The CM performed the Annaprashan ceremony for two children and gave them toys.3- Congress and SP only thought about their own familiesEarlier, the poor would get tired, but they wouldn't even get a toilet. There was no talk of them getting housing either. They wouldn't get it even by paying bribes. Today, they get housing without recommendation. They get a cooking gas connection without recommendation. Why didn't the Congress and Samajwadi Party governments do this work?Who had stopped them? But they lacked the ability. Women power is the direct symbol of Jagat Janani Maa Bhagwati. She knows very well how to deal with Khar and Dushan, Chand and Mund. She will not accept this at all. Because she does not forget this. When the Samajwadi Party is discussed, people tweet something or the other, saying, "Look, the Samajwadi daughter is scared." This is what used to happen in the state.Police were deployed everywhere at the CM's public meeting.4- We made Unnao a part of the State Capital RegionWe have made Unnao a part of the State Capital Region. This means that the development happening in Lucknow will not be limited to Lucknow, but will extend through Unnao to Kanpur. Just as the country's first rapid rail in Delhi has reached from Delhi to Meerut, similarly, we are working on a new proposal for rapid rail from Lucknow through Unnao to Kanpur.A ring road will be built all around. Lucknow, Unnao, Hardoi, Sitapur, Barabanki, and Raebareli, all these districts will be connected, and everyone will have equal participation in development. A large cluster will be formed. Today, UP has a monopoly in expressways. UP has a monopoly in air connectivity.Good people are being elected, which is why development is happening. When wrong people were elected, development was hindered. Their thinking was narrow. Remember, there was one mindset that considered Saifai to be the entire state. And there is the mindset of Modi ji, who has considered the 140 crore people of India as his family.The CM visited the exhibition and gathered information about fruits and vegetables from people who had set up stalls.5- No compromise on national securityNow, there can be no tampering with the country's security. Naxalites, terrorists, and extremists who breach internal security are being responded to. They are being made to realize India's strength. There are only four castes within the country - the poor, (food-provider) farmers, women, and youth.

stories.title: 72 flats given to poor declared illegal:CM Yogi had gifted LDA-built homes 8 months ago; housing complex is on Mukhtar's cleared land
stories.summary: Eight months after Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath handed over flats to 72 poor families in Lucknow, the Irrigation Department has declared the allotments illegal. On Thursday, the department pasted a notice on one of the flats, leaving the beneficiaries worried about their future. It stated: Your house is illegally built on land belonging to the Irrigation Department. Remove the encroachment within 7 days, otherwise the department will vacate it. If any damage occurs after the 7-day deadline expires, you will be solely responsible. You will be charged for damages, expenses, and summons fees. Therefore, remove the illegal encroachment from the department's land within 7 days of receiving this notice. These flats were built by LDA (Lucknow Development Authority) under the Sardar Patel Residential Scheme. The land was previously encroached upon by mafia Mukhtar Ansari, which the administration had freed. The houses were allotted to people in November 2025. Now read in detail LDA had built three blocks in Lucknow's posh area Daliganj is a posh area in Lucknow. Approximately 2,314 square meters of land was under the illegal occupation of mafia Mukhtar Ansari. After freeing it, LDA built three blocks with a ground plus three structure. Each flat has an area of 36.65 square meters, and its price was set at 10.70 lakh rupees. The scheme provides facilities for clean water, electricity, security arrangements, and parking for two-wheelers. Its location is considered very prime. This project, located on Bandha Road, is just 5 to 10 minutes away from Balu Adda, 1090 Chauraha, Narhi, Sikandarbagh, and Hazratganj. Around 8,000 people applied in the online registration opened by LDA from October 4 to November 3 in 2025. Out of these, 72 eligible applicants were allotted flats through a lottery process. On November 4, on the occasion of Sardar Patel Jayanti, the keys to the flats were handed over by CM Yogi. CM Yogi had said - houses should be built for the poor CM Yogi had said on November 4, 2025, while handing over the keys to the allottees: "This land in Lucknow was once occupied by mafias, but today houses for the poor have been built here. It was my wish that when this land is freed from the mafias, homes for the poor should be built on it. Land freed from mafia occupation should become a symbol of public welfare. There is also a message in this - if the mafia occupies the property of the poor, the government, or public property, they will meet the same fate as we did in Lucknow and Prayagraj." He had said in a strict tone: "This is a message for those who consider mafias their patrons. They visit their graves to offer 'Fatiha' and exploit the poor. This will not be tolerated in Uttar Pradesh anymore. Those who become a threat to the safety of the poor, traders, or sisters and daughters, will face the strictest possible action." See 2 photos Now know the action of the Irrigation Department Notice pasted, adjacent houses demolished The Irrigation Department pasted notices on nearby houses and huts after pasting a notice on the wall of a flat on Thursday. After this, action also began. According to local residents, department officials arrived with several bulldozers and police forces. People protested against the officials, after which the officials who came to take action left the spot. Some houses were demolished on the spot. People said - 'Notice put on CM's project' Local resident Rajkumar Tiwari said - A notice has been put up on the Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel residential scheme. The biggest thing is that no one's name is written on this notice. They have started taking direct action on the homes of the poor. It was the Chief Minister's project. LDA prepared it. All the officers are from the Samajwadi Party, that's why they are taking such action. Elections are next year, that's why this is being done. LDA contractor painted over the notice After the Irrigation Department's action, a Dainik Bhaskar reporter reached the spot. There, people were found protesting against the department. Soon after, the LDA contractor who had worked on the Sardar Patel Residential Scheme arrived there with some people. The contractor painted over the Irrigation Department's notice declaring it illegal. Currently, all flats are vacant. No one is living here. Out of 72, 2 allottees could not deposit instalments on time, due to which their allotment was cancelled. LDA has restarted registrations for 2 flats. Its registrations are being done online from June 5 to June 20.

stories.title: 'Papa refused to arrange my marriage, so I killed him':Gorakhpur man shouts loudly from rooftop after murder; attacks father 12 times with axe
stories.summary: A young man in Gorakhpur allegedly killed his father with an axe after becoming frustrated over not getting married. Police said he attacked his father by striking him 12 times on the head in quick succession. After the murder, the accused climbed onto the roof of his house and started shouting loudly. He said- I have killed my father. He was not getting me married. I was tired of asking him every day. Hearing the shouts, the neighbours woke up. They came out of their houses and reached the young man's house, where they saw the father's blood-soaked body lying on the cot. This incident, which occurred around 2 AM on Wednesday late night, is from the Gulriha police station area. Police have taken the accused youth into custody. Know what the matter is Brahmadev Kannaujia (50), a resident of Jangal Ayodhya Prasad Nauka Tola, was a farmer. Two months ago, his wife Bechani Devi passed away. He has three sons - Sonu, Golu, and Mohan. Among them, the elder son Sonu is married, while Golu and Mohan are unmarried. Brahmadev, his elder daughter-in-law Chanda Devi, and Golu lived in the house. According to the police, the elder son Sonu and the youngest son Mohan work as painters in Kerala. Meanwhile, Brahmadev and his middle son Golu lived in the village and worked as labourers. Accused Golu (25) was worried about his marriage. He constantly insisted his father on his marriage. Because of this, there were often arguments between the two. Many times, when the dispute escalated, neighbors had to intervene. According to neighbors, Golu was suffering from some mental illness. Due to his illness and financial reasons, his father was delaying his marriage. Father hacked to death with an axe while sleeping According to the sister-in-law, on Wednesday night, the father and son ate dinner together. After this, Golu again brought up the topic of getting married. On this, the father explained to him that he would get him married soon. This led to a quarrel between the two. After the argument, Brahmadev slept on a cot outside the house, while Golu went to the roof. His sister-in-law was sleeping in a room inside the house. According to the police, around 2 AM, Golu came down from the roof and repeatedly attacked his father, who was sleeping outside, with an axe. Due to severe head injuries and excessive bleeding, Brahmadev died on the spot. After the murder, Golu climbed onto the roof and started shouting loudly that he had killed his father. Hearing the noise, his sister-in-law and nearby residents arrived at the scene. The accused told the people that his father was not getting him married, which is why he hacked him with an axe. After his mother's death, the accused had gone into depression Upon receiving the information, Gulriha police station personnel reached the spot. The police took the body into custody and sent it for post-mortem, and detained the accused Golu. After this, the forensic team collected the necessary evidence from the crime scene. According to the police, Golu had been suffering from depression since his mother's death and was also undergoing treatment. His father, Brahmadev, took care of him. He fed him on time and looked after his needs. Gulriha Station House Officer Jagdish Prasad Pal said- Accused Golu has been taken into custody. Initial investigation has revealed that his mental condition was not stable and he was undergoing treatment. The body has been sent for post-mortem. Further legal action will be taken based on the report and other evidence.

stories.title: VIDEO | Gunman crushed under car in Bijnor:Accused was harassing woman toll employee; turned abusive when confronted
stories.summary: In Bijnor, a youth ran over a gunman with his car at Puraini Toll Plaza. After this, he fled from the scene. According to toll employees, the car driver first made an indecent remark to a female employee. When the woman protested, he started abusing her. Meanwhile, the elderly gunman present there came to intervene, but the accused also got into an argument with him. In a fit of rage, the accused hit the gunman hard with his car. Other employees rushed to save him. Chaos erupted at the scene in no time. After this, the accused fled with the car. In the accident, the gunman's head was split open, while the female employee sustained minor injuries. This incident occurred on Wednesday afternoon, around 1:30 PM, in the Nagina police station area. A video of the incident has also surfaced. The police have registered an FIR against an unknown accused. The police say that the accused is being searched for based on the vehicle number. Meanwhile, considering the serious condition of the injured gunman, he has been referred to Meerut Medical College. Now know the full story On Wednesday, vehicle movement was normal at Puraini Toll Plaza located on the Nagina-Dhampur road. Female employee Shivani was on duty at the toll booth. During this time, a speeding car came and stopped there. According to eyewitnesses, the car driver was under the influence of alcohol. After the toll was paid, he made an indecent remark to the female employee. When she protested, he became rude and started abusing her. Seeing this, gunman Mahipal Singh (65), a resident of Syohara, who was deployed near the booth, came forward to defend the female employee. Mahipal reprimanded the car driver for his actions and instructed him to stay away from the woman and speak politely. He asked him to leave peacefully, but the accused started abusing him as well. An enraged strongman ran over the elderly gunman with his car As the dispute escalated, the car occupant started his car and directly hit Mahipal. The impact was so strong that he was thrown several feet away and seriously injured. He sustained injuries to his head and other parts of his body. After the incident, there was chaos at the toll plaza. Employees present at the scene ran towards him, while the accused car driver fled the spot. After this, toll employees took Mahipal to the hospital. Deep head injury, critical condition After first aid, doctors said that Mahipal had suffered a serious head injury. Due to his critical condition, he was referred to Meerut for better treatment. He is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital. A video of the incident has also surfaced. Family members are demanding the early arrest of the accused. Toll employee said - the car occupant was completely drunk Toll employee Arshad said, "The car driver was completely drunk. He misbehaved with our female staff member Shivani without any reason. When our gunman, Mahipal uncle stopped him, he deliberately ran him over with his car and fled the scene." Efforts to identify the accused are ongoing Nagina CO Rajesh Solanki said, "The incident of a car driver hitting a gunman at Puraini Toll Plaza has come to our attention. The police have inspected the crime scene and seized the CCTV footage from the toll plaza. The car's number is clearly visible in the footage. The accused is being identified based on the number. stories.title: Hindu girl's body dug out 35 days after burial:Family claims Prayagraj's Sahil Khan used fake identity to marry her; mother alleges murder
stories.summary: The reasons behind the death of the young woman who married a Muslim man, believing him to be Hindu, in Prayagraj have not yet come to light. After 35 days, the body of the 20-year-old woman was exhumed for a post-mortem. The body was in a decomposed state. A panel of two doctors conducted the post-mortem, but even the report could not ascertain the clear cause of death. Actually, Sahil, a Muslim man residing in Prayagraj, befriended Goldy, a young woman from Rewa, MP, by posing as a Hindu, and then the two got married. Sahil and Goldy had met on Instagram. Both worked in Hyderabad. Goldy died under suspicious circumstances on May 10, 2026. The young woman's mother alleges that her pregnant daughter was murdered by her in-laws. They poisoned her to death. She also states that she was informed about it on June 6, nearly a month after the death. The police are now engaged in unravelling the mystery of the death. Now know the full case Goldie Saket, 20-year-old daughter of Teerath Saket, a resident of Tamri village in Govindgarh police station area of Rewa district, Madhya Pradesh, used to work in a biscuit factory in Hyderabad. In Hyderabad itself, Sahil alias Prince, a resident of Jari Bazar in Kaundhiyara police station area of Prayagraj, also worked in a tailoring shop. According to Goldie's mother, Baby Devi, the two became friends on Instagram three years ago. Sahil had told his name as Prince. Their conversations gradually turned into a love affair and about six months ago, they both got married in a temple in Hyderabad. Later, Goldie came to know that Prince's real name was Sahil Khan. A dispute arose between the two over this, but Sahil convinced her, and then they got married in a mosque. After some time, Sahil got a job in Surat and took Goldie with him. Baby Devi alleges that Sahil's family members were not happy with this marriage and constantly taunted Goldie. Started assaulting her when she got pregnant The girl's mother said - After she became pregnant in February, she started being assaulted. Distressed, she returned to her parents' home and informed her family about the harassment. However, Sahil later apologised and took her back with him. The mother says that after taking her away, Sahil broke Goldy's SIM card, severing her contact with her family. On June 6, they received information about their daughter's death. After the complaint, when the police started investigating, it was found that Goldy had died on May 10 and was buried in the cemetery the next day. Her family was not even informed about this. Following the family's complaint and the DM's order, the body was exhumed from the grave on June 16. On Wednesday, a panel of two doctors conducted the post-mortem, but the cause of death could not be ascertained. Later, the body was cremated in the presence of the police. Goldy's younger sister, Seetu, alleges that Sahil concealed his identity, trapped her sister in a love affair, married her, and later murdered her. She has demanded a fair investigation into the matter. Accused said - Goldie was unwell Meanwhile, Sahil says that on May 10, 2026, Goldie's health suddenly deteriorated. She was first taken to a private hospital and then to SRN Hospital, where she died during treatment. After this, her last rites were performed on May 11 according to Muslim customs. Assistant Commissioner of Police said - We are investigating Assistant Commissioner of Police Bara Ved Vyas Mishra said- An investigation is being conducted based on the complaint of the girl's family. Sahil's family has been questioned. The family claims that during pregnancy, Goldie complained of vomiting and loose motion, after which her health deteriorated. At that time, Sahil was in Surat.

On Thursday, there is a rain alert in 20 districts and a heatwave alert in 26 districts. During this period, winds may blow at speeds of up to 50 km/h in some places. The heat has increased once again. In the last 24 hours, Prayagraj remained the hottest city in the state. The temperature here was recorded at 45 °C. On Wednesday, Varanasi experienced heavy rainfall. Roads were waterlogged. Prayagraj, Jhansi, and Gorakhpur also received rain. Lucknow's meteorologist, Atul Singh, stated- The monsoon has reached near Maharajganj district on the Bihar border. It is expected that the monsoon may enter UP via Sonbhadra between June 23 and 25. stories.title: Raid at food product factory in Gorakhpur:400 kg mayonnaise and sauce seized, being produced in unsanitary conditions
stories.summary: Tomato sauce, chilli sauce, ketchup and mayonnaise have become staples in many households and fast-food outlets, widely used to enhance the flavour of momos, chowmein, burgers and sandwiches. However, amid rising demand, some manufacturers are allegedly using substandard ingredients, cheap chemicals and artificial colours to maximise profits. In a major crackdown, the Food Safety Department in Gorakhpur raided the Ritima Food Products factory in Suba Bazar, where officials found unhygienic conditions and serious violations of food safety standards. Following the inspection, the department immediately suspended the factory's licence. Around 50 kg of sauce was destroyed on the spot, while approximately 350 kg of sauce and mayonnaise were seized. Samples of chilli sauce, mayonnaise, veg sauce and other products have been collected and sent for laboratory testing. Further action will be taken after the test results are received. Raid conducted following complaints Assistant Commissioner of the Food Safety Department, Dr Sudhir Kumar Singh, said the department had been receiving complaints for some time about substandard sauce being supplied to the market. During the inspection, officials found dirt and unhygienic conditions throughout the factory premises. Flies were swarming around the production area, while vegetables and other ingredients used in the preparation of sauces were reportedly stored in poor condition. Investigators also discovered that the expiry dates of some sauce products had lapsed several months earlier. Despite this, preparations were allegedly being made to repackage and distribute them in the market. In view of these findings, officials immediately destroyed the spoiled stock and seized the remaining products. Chemical colours allegedly used in production Food Safety Department officials also found various chemical-based colouring agents at the factory. It is alleged that these substances were being used to give Red Chilli Sauce its red colour and Green Chilli Sauce its green appearance. The department has launched a detailed investigation into all suspicious materials recovered during the raid. Dr Singh said laboratory reports are expected within a week. If the samples confirm adulteration or violations of food safety regulations, those responsible could face fines, legal proceedings and possible imprisonment. Doctors warn of serious health risks Medical experts have urged consumers to exercise caution. According to Dr B.K. Suman, consuming adulterated or spoiled sauce can lead to food poisoning, vomiting, diarrhoea and severe stomach infections. Long-term consumption may also damage the liver and contribute to gastrointestinal conditions, including stomach ulcers. He added that certain synthetic colours and chemicals used to improve the appearance, thickness and shine of sauces may cause serious health problems over time. Doctors have advised consumers to purchase only reliable, high-quality food products from trusted sources. Public advised to avoid penly stored sauces The Food Safety Department has made it clear that action against those endangering public health will continue. Officials said inspections of stalls and shops selling momos, chowmein and other fast-food items will also be carried out in the coming days. The department has appealed to the public to avoid consuming sauces kept uncovered at roadside stalls and to remain cautious about suspiciously cheap products whose quality and safety cannot be verified.

stories.title: Allahabad HC to hear Ayodhya Temple offering case today:PIL seeks CBI probe and CAG audit; matter to be mentioned for urgent hearing
stories.summary: A hearing is likely to take place on Thursday before the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court on a public interest litigation (PIL) seeking a CBI investigation into the alleged embezzlement of offerings and financial irregularities in Ayodhya, along with an audit by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG). The matter has been listed before the division bench comprising Justice Saurabh Lavania and Justice Pramod Kumar Srivastava in Court Number 2. Case listed before division bench According to advocate Mohit Ashok Sharma, appearing for the petitioner, the matter has been listed as Item Number 466 in Court Number 2 in the cause list dated 18 June 2026. He said that a special mention of the case would be made before the division bench in the morning, requesting that the matter be taken up for an early hearing. The advocate stated that no final update had yet been received from the Section Officer regarding the hearing schedule. He added that, if required, the matter could also be included in the supplementary list. However, whether the case is ultimately heard on Thursday will depend entirely on the court's discretion and priorities. May be treated as a matter of national importance According to the petitioner's counsel, if the bench considers the issue to be one of wider public interest and national importance, and finds that it warrants urgent consideration, the matter could be taken up for hearing on the same day. However, the final position will become clear only after the special mention is made before the court. PIL seeks CBI investigation and CAG audit The public interest litigation seeks an investigation by an independent agency into the alleged misuse of funds linked to offerings in Ayodhya and other alleged financial irregularities. The petition also calls for a comprehensive audit of the matter by the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG). The issue has reportedly sparked growing discussion in religious, social and political circles, with interest increasing ahead of the court's decision on whether to hear the matter.

stories.title: Samajwadi Party split buzz grows in UP:Rajbhar hints at Ballia Brahmin MP as rebel face; Nishad claims 24 opposition MPs are in touch with BJP
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar has once again claimed that the Samajwadi Party (SP) is headed for a split. In a post on X at 7 am on Thursday, he hinted at a senior leader who could lead a rebellion within the party. Rajbhar has made similar claims three times in the past 24 hours. Backing Rajbhar's assertion, Uttar Pradesh minister Sanjay Kumar Nishad claimed that several SP and Congress MPs in the state are in touch with the ruling alliance and are seeking political opportunities. "All SP and Congress MPs in Uttar Pradesh who follow a Hindu ideology keep meeting us for opportunities and to establish contact with the leadership in Delhi. Their number is no less than two dozen," Nishad said. In his post, Rajbhar wrote that a leader from Uttar Pradesh's "rebel land" would lead a group of dissident SP MPs. He claimed the leader was upset after Brahmins were allegedly insulted during a conference held at the SP office. Rajbhar said the plan to rebel had existed earlier, but the recent incident had intensified the discontent. He claimed a split in the SP was now certain and advised party chief Akhilesh Yadav to focus on saving his MPs instead of engaging in politics through social media, air-conditioned rooms and press conferences. He also suggested that Akhilesh meet dissatisfied MPs and apologise to them. When Bhaskar spoke to SP leaders about Rajbhar's remarks, they referred to a meeting held at the party office in Lucknow on Monday. Akhilesh Yadav had met members of the Brahmin community before addressing a press conference. Mau MP Rajeev Rai, Ballia MP Sanatan Pandey and Sultanpur MP Ram Bhual Nishad were present at the event. Political observers believe Rajbhar's remarks were aimed at Ballia MP Sanatan Pandey, who is currently SP's lone MP from the district. Rajbhar made similar claims twice on Wednesday; Akhilesh hit back Earlier on Wednesday, Rajbhar claimed twice that a split was likely in the SP. Speaking to ANI, he said that after Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh would be next. He also alleged that SP leader Ram Gopal Yadav had given a letter to Union Home Minister Amit Shah regarding some MPs. Akhilesh Yadav responded to the claim on social media. He said those making predictions should first predict the future of their own party and asked whether the BJP would give them 75 seats, 50 seats or only assurances. He also alleged that rumours about receiving 30 seats in the BJP alliance had been spread after taking advance money. Rajbhar later reposted Akhilesh's remarks on X and said trouble was brewing within the SP. He challenged Akhilesh to save his party if he could. Keshav Maurya also claims SP MPs may leave Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya had also made a similar claim in Kanpur on Wednesday. He said the SP could face a major setback in the future and that 25 to 26 of its MPs were in a position to leave the party. However, he added that the BJP was not involved in any politics of defections.

stories.title: Tempo traveller carrying 29 tourist falls into gorge in Nainital:2 women dead, 27 injured, 21 in critical condition; victims from Meerut and Ghaziabad
stories.summary: Two women were killed and 27 people injured after a tourist Tempo Traveller plunged nearly 25 metres into a gorge near Nainital Tirahe on Khurpatal Road late on Wednesday night. 21 are reported to be in a serious condition. The vehicle was carrying tourists from Meerut and Ghaziabad in Uttar Pradesh, who had visited Nainital for a holiday and were returning home when the accident occurred about 4 kilometres before Kaladhungi. The crash triggered panic at the scene, with passengers crying out for help as local residents and passers-by rushed to assist before emergency services arrived. See pictures- Complete incident in 5 points 1. Tourists trapped inside the vehicle According to police, a call was received on Dial-112 at 8:08 pm on Wednesday, reporting that a Tempo Traveller had fallen off the road on Khurpatal Road and several passengers were trapped inside. Teams from the Police, State Disaster Response Force (SDRF), Fire Service and District Administration immediately reached the spot. With the help of local residents and passers-by, rescue teams pulled the trapped passengers out of the vehicle and shifted all the injured to the Community Health Centre (CHC) in Kaladhungi for first aid. Doctors at the CHC declared two women dead, 32-year-old Nazreen and around 40-year-old Farad Begum, both residents of Meerut. 2. All passengers were from Meerut and Ghaziabad A total of 29 people, including the driver, were travelling in the Tempo Traveller (registration number UP 15 FT 6795) at the time of the accident. Most of the passengers were residents of Meerut and Ghaziabad in Uttar Pradesh. Preliminary information suggests that the group had travelled to Nainital for sightseeing and was returning home when the vehicle was involved in an accident. 3. 21 seriously injured referred to Haldwani 21 critically injured passengers were referred to Sushila Tiwari Hospital in Haldwani for specialised treatment. The injured include children, women and men. Among those referred are Nawabuddin, Asif, Reshma, Rukhsana, Anees Ahmed, Naimuddin, Nafees, Sana, Ayesha, Monis and several others. Treatment of the injured is continuing at the hospital. 4. Senior officials oversaw rescue operation Following information about the accident, Superintendent of Police (City) Haldwani Manoj Katyal, Deputy Superintendent of Police Haldwani Amit Kumar Saini, and Station House Officer Arun Kumar Saini reached the scene along with police personnel. Teams from the SDRF, Fire Service and District Administration also participated in the rescue and relief operation. Senior officials monitored the rescue efforts and ensured that the injured were shifted to hospitals without delay. 5. Investigation underway into cause of crash Police have taken possession of the damaged vehicle and launched an investigation into the circumstances leading to the accident. Preliminary findings indicate that the Tempo Traveller went out of control before plunging off the road into the gorge. Authorities are examining the exact cause of the crash. List of injured passengers A total of 27 people sustained injuries in the accident on the Kaladhungi-Khurpatal Road. The injured include men, women and young children. The injured have been identified as Samir, Jasim Ahmed (11), Abuzar (8), Monis (23), Nawabuddin (45), Haider, Asif (24), Bablu, driver Naimuddin (33), Anees Ahmed (55), Shad (2), Aman (18), Mohammad Arsan (14), Suhail (23), Nafees (45), Shahzad (34), Suhaiya (10), Fiza Ur Rahman, Aina (9), Tasbiya (11), Reshma (36), Sana (23), Rukhsana (45), Laiba (25), Kulviya, Mahira (18 months), Ayesha (21), Junaira (15), Shahnaz, Farhad (46), Anisa (40), Nisha (21) and Sufiya (16). All the injured were rescued from the wreckage with the help of local residents and emergency teams before being rushed for treatment. Those with serious injuries are currently undergoing treatment at Sushila Tiwari Hospital in Haldwani.
